title: Arrival Day
public: The ferry Second Chance brings the new students to Caldera Key. She docks at 10:40.
gm: DAY 1, MORNING, ABOARD THE FERRY: the ship is four places with no travel time (ferry_deck, ferry_lounge, ferry_stern, ferry_bridge); the Hours line of each says who is there, what they are doing and whether they will play. Use only @clock aboard, never @time. She docks at 10:40: then @place ferry_dock, and the walk up to the Quad. All 36 first-years are strangers to each other and to Rowan. In the lounge a quarrel over the one card table is coming to a head (hook h_ferry_table). The opening scene is the player's to use: he may stay at the rail, walk the ship, talk to anyone, challenge people to casual games or be challenged (Inya; Magnus if he hears the handle), put credits on a game with Tomi, or step into the quarrel. Let him meet people by what they are doing, not by introduction; names come when people give them. NOBODY KNOWS ANYBODY: the only exceptions are family (the Capulet sisters) and whatever people have learned of each other since the harbour. Keep it light and wide-eyed. Rowan is a late Wildcard qualifier: his name is handwritten at the bottom of the passenger list by the wheelhouse door, and he is the only first-year without a jacket.

title: The Ferry Docks
public: The Second Chance ties up at the Academy pier at 10:40. The walk up to the Quad takes ten minutes.
gm: ONLY IF ROWAN IS STILL ON THE SHIP (his place is ferry_deck, ferry_lounge, ferry_stern or ferry_bridge): she docked at 10:40 while he was busy, and it is eleven. Begin this answer with the gangway down and the decks emptying; a talk or a game in progress was cut short by the horn, and a wager that was not played out stands and is settled ashore. Write @place ferry_dock at once and take him up the avenue towards the Quad, where the welcome address is beginning (next entry). If he is already ashore, ignore this entry.

title: Welcome Address & Dorm Assignment
public: The Chancellor welcomes the new intake on the Quad; dorm lists are read out.
gm: Okonkwo's short, formidable speech from the main steps; Octavia reads the lists in rank order — Spectral, Rare, then the Commons. Rowan, having qualified two weeks after admissions closed, is read out last of all: the Commons, bungalow 7, with N. Whisper and B. Halvorsen. Red Competitive Play jacket issued from a crate, with the plain grey collar of the Commons. Mama Odalys collects 'her' eighteen first-years and marches them down to the cove. First sight of the bungalow row and of the room. If the player sulks about the Commons, let Odalys feed him.

title: Placement Duel
public: Every new student plays one Placement Duel in the Trial Domes to set a starting ladder rank.
gm: Rowan's first game ever on a physical table in front of people (exam-kind duel; witnesses on the benches, Hana judging, Santángel watching for four minutes and leaving). Opponent: an upper-year volunteer from the distant crowd, or Rana Marika (they have not met; she is simply the name drawn) — she is repeating the year and takes it badly either way. His reads are brilliant and his hands shake; let the player feel both. Result sets the first ladder rank (of 144: roughly 120–135). Losing is fine and expected. Rox notes the tremor and says nothing yet.

title: Welcome Supper at the Commons
public: Mama Odalys cooks for the whole bungalow row.
gm: The Commons at one table. Eighteen first-years who met this morning, bungalow by bungalow, each in one beat (use names only as people give them): Freya very upright and very cool, Hedda asking what is in the stew, Trixie with something alive in a matchbox (B2); Maisie taking the pepper mill apart, Fiona in black lace saying grace in a deep voice, Leona — ordinary, pleasant, forgettable — choosing the seat nearest the door (B4); Ed asking which part of the island is forbidden (B5); Sammy in a long coat at the table's end being silent at people, Tobias eating like someone who counts meals, Dmitri wide awake when everyone else is fading (B6). And the ones Rowan will know best: Tomi already trading, Livvie eating very fast and very neatly, Rana at the far end not talking, Viktor arriving late with mud to the knee, Inya defending bunnies, Nathan telling Rowan he snores 'so you know'. Odalys's house rules: nobody eats alone, nobody skips breakfast, lights out means quiet. Ends with the first night in bungalow 7 — Nathan does snore.

title: Orientation Day
public: 09:00 Lecture Hall: welcome, staff, the three majors, the Ladder, the Charter. 11:00 guided campus tours by dorm from the fountain, lunch at 12:30, second half until about 15:00.
gm: ORIENTATION DAY follows the timed plan under FIXED TIMES TODAY, step by step and complete: 09:00 the Chancellor's welcome and the Charter → every member of staff → the three majors, Ladder, credits, grades → Charter Duels, house rules, student council → the Founder, timetables, tour groups → 11:00 guided tour (first half) → 12:30 lunch → 13:15 guided tour (second half) → about 15:00 free. Each step is played out in full when its time comes; nothing is skipped or summarised. Before nine the first-years have breakfast and walk up together. Whoever stays away misses it.

title: Classes Begin
public: First day of lectures. Check your timetable: first bell 08:40, Morning class 09:00–10:30, Midday class 11:30–13:00.
gm: First class of the year (Wednesday: Lore & History in the Morning, Table Practicum at Midday). Establish the rhythm: classes fill Morning and Midday, everything after is Rowan's own time. Skipping is possible and is counted.

title: Club Fair
public: Clubs and societies recruit on the Quad: theatre, Judge Circle, swim squad, astronomy, outdoor, gardening, The Top Deck and more. 14:30 stalls open, 15:30 demonstrations on the fountain steps, sign-up sheets close at 17:00.
gm: Stalls round the fountain, run by Pilar, the council's events secretary; Teobalt, three days on the island like everyone else, already holds her clipboard, and Sebastian, the vice-president, stamps club charters. Hedda has a stall of her own that nobody authorised (three causes, one megaphone) until Pilar moves it; Ed signs up for the outdoor club before its leader has finished the safety talk; Trixie asks the gardening club about bees; Eloise is painting the theatre club's banner instead of joining anything. Each club is a door to a character: theatre (Marit, in full flight), Judge Circle (Noor, exact and shy), swim squad (Sunny, flirting immediately), The Top Deck (Bex, wants 'a Commons voice'), photo club (Pippa), gardening (Wren, half asleep), outdoor club (unnamed leader; Viktor signs up only to see their maps). Rowan can join up to two without his grades suffering. Missing the fair only delays this.

title: Commons Bonfire Mixer
public: The first Friday bonfire of the year at the Commons cove. All dorms welcome. 18:00 wood and grill, fire lit at 18:45, firelight duels from 20:15, the talking shell at 21:00, embers about 22:00.
gm: The first big social scene (Evening into Night). Everyone here has known everyone else for five days at most; no old friendships, no in-jokes older than Monday. By name: Freya discovers the drinks and by the second verse is conducting the singing with a bottle; Hedda inspects the grill; Sammy stands at the edge of the light being mysterious at nobody; Cas narrates the marshmallows; Rafa feeds people; Trixie introduces a moth; Fiona tells a ghost story in her deep voice and three boys forget to breathe (Sammy, Tobias, and Gideon Pryce at the very edge of the light, pretending to be leaving); Victoria sits on a log with her parasol open against the sparks, Ophelia two logs behind her. Other dorms come down: Marit makes an entrance, Sunny arrives wet from the sea, Jessica comes 'to see how the other half lives' and stays longer than she meant to, Ashton hands out roses, Willas carries the wood for everybody and shouts at someone for dropping a log. Firelight duels with no holograms: Rowan's gentlest first games in front of people. The talking shell goes round — whoever holds it tells a true story; Nathan's is long and embarrassing. Most routes can be opened here. If Rowan stays away, he hears the row singing through the plank wall.

title: First Town Saturday
public: The first free Saturday: shuttle carts to Port Mulligan leave the main gate on the hour from 09:00 to 12:00 (sign out at the lodge). Last cart back from Main Street at 21:30; the gate shuts at 22:00.
gm: Port Mulligan opens up: Main Street, the harbour, the Sleeve & Binder (Dex and Mika; Rowan needs sleeves and a mat, and discovers what singles cost), the café, the arcade. Unlock town places as he walks them. Tomi explains prices; Livvie sells a rare with a face like stone. In the Evening the first Night Market (separate entry). Rowan's money is tight: let the laundromat arithmetic show without comment.

title: Night Market
public: Port Mulligan's Night Market on the old customs yard, every second Saturday from dusk: lanterns up at 18:00, stalls until late. Last cart back to the Academy at 21:30.
gm: Lanterns, skewers, foreign-language printings. At the far end Madame Oru reads spreads from the customer's own deck for 5 cr. Her readings are true and vague: if Rowan sits down now she turns three of his cards and says he sleeps in a room of three, and that one of them 'will keep the bed and lose the sleeper'. No explanation, no repeat. It should read as carnival patter today.

title: Beach Day at Driftwood Cove
public: Swim squad and Commons invite everyone to the cove west of the bungalows. Lifeguard on duty 14:00–17:00. 14:30 volleyball, 15:15 first surfing lesson, towel tables all afternoon.
gm: Sun, volleyball, a rope swing, cards weighted with shells. Sunny lifeguards and flirts; Saoirse offers a first surfing lesson; Baylee gets sunburnt in real time; Nathan cannonballs onto somebody's playmat; Georgie is there with Pippa, in a sun hat, annihilating upper-years at a towel table. Pure warmth. This is the island the story later takes away.

title: Judge Circle: First Meeting
public: Weekly rules circle in Seminar Room 2B, Mondays 19:00–20:45. Newcomers welcome; bring a ruling you got wrong.
gm: Noor chairs, Hana supervises from the back, Mika comes up from town. A dozen students argue corner cases. Good for Rules & Judging study, for Noor's slow route and Hana's. Noor can quote the charter's duel clause from memory when asked; plant that she is the person who knows it by heart.

title: Teobalt's birthday
public: Teobalt's birthday. Cake in the council chamber at 16:00; leftovers go round the dorms afterwards.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Teobalt; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). The council delegates surprise him with a cake shaped like a clipboard; he has scheduled eleven minutes for it. Helping him carry leftover cake round the dorms is an easy way to meet half the school.

title: The Top Deck: Season Premiere
public: The campus stream returns, live from the broadcast studio. Studio audience welcome: doors 18:30, on air 19:00–19:40 (ladder predictions, ones to watch, rules quiz).
gm: Bex's show: ladder predictions, freshman 'ones to watch' (Georgie, Gideon, Ashton — and a throwaway joke about 'the Wildcard kid with the online handle'), a rules quiz. If Rowan is in the audience she may pull him on air for thirty seconds: a first, small public-nerve test. Crew shifts are available from tonight.

title: Ladder Deck Registration Deadline
public: Register your decklist with the council clerk to play ranked in Season 1: the desk is open 14:00–18:00 and closes at the Evening bell. Late forms: ten ranks' penalty.
gm: A form in triplicate at the council chamber; Noor checks every list against the legality sheet. If Rowan forgets, he can still register late with a 10-rank penalty. Octavia looks at his grey collar, his handle and his list, in that order, and files him. Sebastian Thorne has the next desk, Permits & Sanctions: late forms and the ten-rank penalty are his to rule on, warmly and to the letter.

title: Ed's Expedition No. 1: The Blowhole
public: 'Meet at the tide pools at low water — 15:00. Bring nothing you mind losing. Back before the tide, about 16:45.' — E. Venture
gm: A hand-drawn poster on the Commons boardwalk. The blowhole at the north end of the pools throws spray four metres on a rising tide and Ed wants to stand on it. Merely stupid rather than lethal; Viktor has come, he says, to see the pools. (Plot file: q_ed_places_to_die.)

title: Trixie's birthday
public: Trixie's birthday. Cake at Mama's Kitchen after supper, about 19:00.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Trixie; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). The first birthday on the row and nobody has known her ten days: Mama bakes anyway. Trixie cries with happiness, names the cake, and gives the first slice to the bee hotel 'for the girls'.

title: Movie Night
public: Student lounge, pull-down screen, bring a cushion. Seats from 19:30, film at 20:00, out by 22:00. Tonight: an old pirate picture.
gm: Low-stakes evening; whoever Rowan sits next to gets a quiet scene in the dark. Marit narrates until silenced. Runs every other Thursday.

title: Ladder Season 1 Opens
public: Ranked play begins: the board goes live on the Quad at 07:45, Prof. Santángel opens the season at 08:05. Challenge anyone within 20 ranks of you; book a Trial Dome or meet on the Terraces.
gm: The split-flap board clatters to life and the terraces fill. Explain the ladder loop: ranked duels move rank; top 8 at snapshot dates qualify for events. Brant and his two hangers-on start 'trading' first-years (Sammy, Trixie, Mikoto) out of their rares on the middle terrace — Nathan tells him loudly what he thinks of that. Lilia's name sits at #1 with a gap under it.

title: Freya's First Friday
public: A beach party at Driftwood Cove after the bonfire, from 20:30; night swim about 21:15. 'Bring a cup.' — F. Nordlicht, Bungalow 2.
gm: Twelve days into term and Freya Nordlicht already runs the island's social calendar. Swimming in the dark, a driftwood fire, far too much to drink. She is magnificent until about one and then needs walking home (plot file: q_freya_northern_lights). A good night to meet the first year out of uniform; people are still learning each other's names.

title: Harbour Market Day
public: The big monthly market fills Main Street and the quay from 08:30 to 14:00: produce, second-hand cards, carved dice. Carts from the main gate on the hour.
gm: Bigger than the weekly stalls. Odalys shops for the week with Baylee and Rafa as porters (job-like favour). Second-hand playmats and binders cheap; one stall of old printings worth digging through.

title: Lore & History Field Section
public: Optional Saturday walk with Professor Ashdown to the old ruins beyond the rope bridge. Sign up at the faculty wing; bring water and boots. Roll call at the main gate 11:00, on site about 13:00, back by 16:30.
gm: A long day out (jungle trail, rope bridge — a small Nerve test — ruins field). Ashdown lectures on site, crisp and guarded; students take rubbings for credit. The first sight of the mosaics; some figures look like card heroes. Viktor comes for the first and only time and asks where the avenue leads; she says 'to a rock face' and changes the subject. One trench stays under a tarpaulin. Counts as study for Lore. A second section is announced for Day 41 and never takes place.

title: Dorm Inspection
public: Termly room inspection by wardens and council delegates. Tidy up. The Commons row: at your doors at 11:00, bungalows in order from 11:15, results read out on the kitchen porch at 12:40.
gm: Teobalt with a clipboard, Odalys with the spoon. Bungalow 7: Baylee's corner is perfect, Nathan's is a crime scene. A failed inspection costs the room a weekend chore; helping Nathan shovel his side clean the night before is a roommate scene worth having. Teobalt notes the leaking roof and, within the week, gets it fixed. Tavita Leota, the head proctor, leads the delegates round with the warden: he explains the rule, gives each room its one free warning and writes a slip only the second time.

title: The Founder's Story Hour
public: Open door at Chuck Kaboom's workshop behind the Design Lab, Mondays 15:00–16:45: tea, a story at 15:15, then games against the Founder. Facts not guaranteed.
gm: First chance to meet Chuck up close. He tells a story 'from when I knew them' with total conviction; plays anyone against his impossible mixed pile. Inya sits at the back pretending to be an ordinary fan and he pretends not to know her — badly, both of them. The oldest sketches on the wall are worth a look. Recurs most Mondays.

title: Eberhart's birthday
public: Eberhart's birthday. He is in the gym from 18:30, as on any other evening.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Eberhart; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). He trains. Mikoto has made a banner (HAPPY BIRTHDAY EBI) and hung it in R101; it stays up exactly one day and then appears, folded square, in Eberhart's footlocker, where it stays all year.

title: Freshman Cup Practice Night
public: Open practice on the Terraces, 18:30–21:15. Freshman Cup registration (first-years only, free entry) at the registrar's table tonight; it closes on Thursday.
gm: Every first-year is testing. Good moment to learn decks (deck knowledge on several classmates), to be taught something by a friend, and for Rana — who must play the Freshman Cup a second time — to snap at anyone who mentions it. Tomi opens a betting pool; Georgie is the favourite at odds nobody will take. Registration closes on Day 18; not registering costs standing with Coach Rox.

title: Inter-Dorm Swim Meet
public: Dorm relays at the pool. Swimmers and timekeepers wanted. Warm-up 14:30, individual heats 15:00, dorm relays 15:40, results 16:10.
gm: Rare Hall wins because of Sunny; the Commons relay needs a fourth and looks at Rowan. Taking part is worth fitness and affection; timekeeping from the lifeguard chair is a Sunny scene. Jessica presides from a lounger.

title: Inya's birthday
public: Inya's birthday. Cake at Mama's Kitchen after supper, 19:00.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Inya; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). Mama bakes a tres leches with a bunny piped on it. An unsigned parcel arrives by the kitchen door: a hand-carved wooden rabbit, old, the paint worn — from Chuck, though she tells the table it is 'from home'. Tomorrow morning her legal name goes up on the Freshman Cup roster; tonight is the last evening she is only Inya Bell. If she trusts Rowan, she may tell him herself tonight.

title: Freshman Cup
public: Two-day tournament for all first-years. Friday: roster on the arena doors 08:00, check-in at the Trial Domes 09:00, players' meeting 10:30, Swiss rounds at 11:00, 11:50, 13:20 and 14:10, standings 15:00. Saturday: bracket draw 10:00, top 8 in the Great Arena from 14:00. First-years are excused from Friday’s classes.
gm: Rowan's first tournament (tournament-kind duels; Nerve matters). The roster goes up in the Morning on the arena doors and at the job board with LEGAL NAMES: 'KABOOM, Inya' — a crowd forms, the reverent whispering she hates begins, and how Rowan treats her in the next hour matters a great deal. Day 1: four Swiss rounds from Midday (two or three played out, the rest summarised). Georgie goes undefeated without looking up; Gideon is smooth and contemptuous of grey collars; Rana, repeating, chokes at match point in round three unless someone steadies her. Scouts from the inn watch. Scorekeepers and runners for the Cup are on Pilar's crew list (20 cr a day) and are paid the same evening at Imara's table in the council room.

title: Second Desk: Freshman Cup
public: The Top Deck's second desk covers the outer tables of the Freshman Cup: first-year Auxiliary students on the microphone, live from 11:15 with round 1.
gm: Cas Abernathy calls the play; Victoria Capulet, beside him, says nothing about the game at all and describes the cards — borders, palettes, the expression of a creature — in complete serious sentences. Bex wants her off after ninety seconds; chat wants more. Ophelia watches from the studio door with her arms crossed. (Plot file: q_victoria_aesthetics.)

title: Freshman Cup: Top 8 & Final
public: Top 8 on the Great Arena stage, cast live by The Top Deck. Doors 14:00, quarter-finals 14:30, semi-finals 15:30, final 16:40. Prize-giving at dusk (17:30): 400 cr and a line on the arena wall.
gm: The arena stage, lights, a crowd: if Rowan made top 8 this is the first great Nerve test; if not, he watches from the stands with whoever he chooses. Default result (plot timeline): Georgie beats Inya in the semi-final and Gideon in the final, 2–0; Gideon is gracious on camera and breaks a pen in the corridor. If Rowan is still in, the bracket is his to change. Lilia watches the final from the tunnel mouth and leaves before the handshake; if Rowan played with spine she remembers his handle. Night Market in town this evening.

title: Saoirse's birthday
public: Saoirse's birthday. No party: she is at the boathouse from 14:00, surfing; turn up and you get a board.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Saoirse; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). No party: she takes the day off everything and surfs. Anyone who turns up at the boathouse gets handed a board. Dom leaves a wrapped rulebook on her hammock as a joke; she uses it to level the camp stove.

title: Picket at the Commons Kitchen
public: 'MEAT IS MURDER (ALSO ON TUESDAYS).' Hedda Njord pickets Mama's lunch, from 13:05 at the kitchen steps. Megaphone expected.
gm: Hedda, one placard, one megaphone, against a woman with a wooden spoon who has fed this row for twelve years. Baylee eats on the steps. It ends when Mama lifts the lid of the pot that has stood on the back ring since Day 3 with an H chalked on it — nothing in it that ever had a face; Rafa has been improving it daily — and says, 'Thirty paces from my stove with that horn, mija, or you peel.' Hedda peels. (Plot file: q_hedda_cause.)

title: Study Group Sign-Up
public: First-year study groups form in the Library after dinner: sign-up at 19:00, first session 19:20–20:20, tables by course. Groups then meet Mondays and Thursdays at 19:00.
gm: Standing groups for the term: Probability with Noor and Teobalt (Georgie corrects the answer key), Rules, Lore. Joining one gives steady study progress on that course every week it meets (Monday and Thursday Evenings) and is the low-effort way to keep grades up. Baylee struggles with the reading and will not ask; noticing is a friendship beat.

title: Squall Warning
public: Harbourmaster's notice: strong squall expected from the south-west this evening, from about 18:45 until 21:00. Boats in, shutters closed by 18:30.
gm: The first real weather: horizontal rain, the bungalow roofs leak, the boardwalk floods. The Commons spends the evening bailing and laughing; Baylee holds a shutter on with his bare hands, Nathan narrates. A good night for a quiet scene in the kitchen or the greenhouse with whoever ran in from the rain. By morning it is washed clean and bright.

title: Stargazing Night
public: The astronomy club opens the old observatory on the hill: clear skies forecast. Doors 22:00, turns at the telescope until about 23:20, closed at midnight. Bring a jacket.
gm: The brass refractor, the slit of stars, cocoa in a flask. A quiet, lovely night two days before everything changes; whoever Rowan stands next to at the eyepiece will remember it with him. Pippa photographs star trails over the dark north ridge. Viktor is on the catwalk watching a house with no lamps, not the sky.

title: Cas's birthday
public: Cas's birthday. A surprise for him in the broadcast studio at 19:15 — be there by 19:00 and keep quiet.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Cas; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). He commentates his own surprise party from the moment the lights come on ('and they have gone with the classic hide-behind-the-desk formation') and cannot stop until Rafa puts food in his mouth.

title: Friday Night Draft
public: Booster draft at the Sleeve & Binder. Entry 60 cr, keep what you pick. Sign-up 18:30, draft 19:00, three rounds from 20:05, done by 21:15.
gm: Eight-player pods at the back tables; Mika judges with a sleepy smile. Nathan drafts badly and loudly and has the time of his life; on the walk home along the harbour road he tells Rowan, unprompted, that this is the best month he has ever had. Let it be the last ordinary evening. He goes to bed still talking.

title: THE BANG
gm: 02:10 (see the plot timeline and its hooks; this entry only sets the stage). A concussion that lifts dust from the rafters and a green-white flash through the shutters; every window on the island rattles. The whole bungalow row is out on the boardwalk in blankets; a glow over the north slope fades in a minute. {H?{H=nathan?About half past two {H}, banging a pan, Tomi's good torch belted to his head, deck box in his jacket 'in case it wants a game', announces that it is a crashed spaceship, that he will be the first human to shake hands with it, and that everyone else is a coward — and goes up the jungle trail alone with two of Mama's empanadas. Rowan may go after him: {H} outpaces him in the dark and he loses him at the rope bridge. Nobody stops {H}. This is the last time Rowan sees him alive.|{H=baylee?Nathan and the pan, as always: spaceship, cowards, up the jungle trail alone at half past two with Tomi's torch. Then he fills a water bottle at the kitchen tap, says to whoever is nearest — Rowan, if he is awake — 'Somebody ought to walk behind him,' and follows, without a light, at the pace of a man walking a fence line. Nobody stops him; nobody thinks of it. Nathan's torch dies at the rope bridge and he is back by four, scratched and loud, having met no one: Baylee had taken the old cattle track to come out above him. People cheer her off. Nathan's torch dies at the rope bridge; he finds her sitting on it finishing the bottle, tells her the whole thing is closed, and is home by four. When the bottle was empty she went on, because the other way led to a quiet room. Play it as comedy. Do NOT telegraph anything: this is Freya being Freya.|{H=hedda?Nathan and the pan, as always: spaceship, cowards, up the jungle trail alone at half past two with Tomi's torch. She goes up after his torch with the megaphone and her tin of bandages, still shouting statistics over her shoulder. People laugh. At five Sunny Aldane comes down from Rare Hall for her run, hears from Dmitri [dmitri] on his porch that somebody went up the mountain alone in the dark, does not wait for the rest of the sentence, and runs: three hours' hike is seventy minutes at her pace. title: THE MORNING AFTER
gm: The clock tower stands at 02:10 until Silas restarts it. {H}'s bed is empty. On the far north slope there is a 40-metre crater of fused black glass, three hours' hike away, and for two days nothing stops a student going (hike 3: most of the day). At dawn {H} reached it first and died there; what walks back into the Commons at Midday with glass dust in its hair is THE GUEST. {H=nathan?It grins {H}'s grin, says it found 'a big hole, nothing in it', eats six plates, and does not insult anyone.|It wears {H}'s face exactly, {H:ret}.} From now on play the replacement exactly as CORE 4.3 describes: nearly perfect, slightly literal, kind. The gulls leave the cove within the week.

title: The Top Deck: Special Broadcast
public: Unscheduled live special from the studio about last night's noise and light: on air 12:30–13:20, eyewitness calls welcome.
gm: Bex is first with it: eyewitness calls, Pippa's star-trail plate with a green streak across it, a rumour of 'a crater'. The staff line by evening is 'a meteorological event; nothing to worry about'. Bex wants someone to go up and look. If Rowan was on the boardwalk he is a witness she wants on air.

title: Pippa's birthday
public: Pippa's birthday. Party in the Rare Hall common room from 15:00 (paper crowns provided); cake at 16:00.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Pippa; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). Marit throws her a party with a paper-crown photo booth; Georgie has made a card by hand and is rigid with worry that it is babyish. Pippa is distracted: she spent the morning in the darkroom with the plate from the observatory, and the streak in it slows down before it lands.

title: North Slope Closed
public: Chancellor's notice (posted 07:30): all trails beyond the rope bridge are closed until further notice because of unstable ground. Field sections suspended. The bridge is watched by day and chained from dusk.
gm: The cordon (canon, Day 29): staff tape and a rota at the north trailhead — the campus-side anchor of the rope bridge — by day, a chain at night, tape at the crater. Officially unstable ground. Ashdown argued against the closure and lost; Silas hung the chain. Anyone who went up on Days 27–28 saw the crater open; from now on it takes a Night slot, the coast, the tubes, or Viktor, and being caught inside the cordon is a formal warning.

title: All-School Assembly
public: The Chancellor addresses the school in the Great Arena about Friday night's event. Attendance expected: seated by 14:15, over by about 15:00.
gm: Okonkwo, calm and exact: a meteorite, no danger, the site is closed for everyone's safety, lessons continue. Blum is asked to say something reassuring about meteorites and cheerfully gives the odds, which are terrible. In the stands '{H}' asks Rowan, interested, why everyone is sitting in rows facing one person. Students laugh. It is a good question.

title: Movie Night
public: Student lounge. Tonight, by popular demand: a flying-saucer double bill. Seats 19:00, first film 19:20, second film 20:40, out by 22:00.
gm: The school is still treating the bang as a joke. '{H}' comes along, watches the invasion film with complete attention, laughs half a second after everyone else every time, and afterwards says quietly that the visitors in it were 'very rude: they did not ask what the rules were'.

title: Ladder Snapshot I
public: First ranking snapshot of the season at the Evening bell (18:00); results stamped before the bell count. At 18:15 the top 8 non-team players are seeded into Friday's Battle Team tryouts.
gm: The board freezes at the bell and a crowd watches it. Top 8 non-team players get seeds for the tryout; everyone else may still enter the open bracket. Somebody notices that {H:sig} has climbed forty places in four days.

title: Georgie's birthday
public: Georgie's birthday. Party in the Rare Hall common room at 18:30; helpers for Pippa welcome from 17:30.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Georgie; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). Pippa has planned it for weeks: the first birthday party Georgie has ever had with people near her own age. Paper dragons, a cake with a plastic egg on it, Willas in a party hat daring anyone to comment. Keep it bright and childlike. Helping Pippa set it up, or simply turning up and playing Georgie a serious game as her present, counts for a great deal with both of them. Tryouts are tomorrow; someone should tell her she is allowed to enter.

title: Battle Team Open Tryouts
public: Open tryouts for one reserve slot on the Battle Team. Any student may enter. Coach Delgado presiding. Sign-in 14:00, circuits 14:20, tables from 15:00, final table 16:40. Result tomorrow at 09:15.
gm: Rox runs it like a fitness test: circuits, then duels against team members while exhausted; Priya drills the first-years and is the fairest assessor there. One slot: second reserve. Rowan can enter (tournament-kind; hard) — surviving to the final table is enough to be noticed by Lilia. Default (plot timeline): Gideon Pryce gets the slot, unless Georgie has been encouraged to try out or Rowan earns it. '{H}' enters, beats two starters' practice decks flawlessly, and is turned down by Rox for 'not looking tired — I don't trust it'. Lilia watches every game {H:he} plays with the first interest she has shown all year. Willas loses his temper at Mikoto, who cannot stop laughing through the circuits, and then lends him his water. Result posted tomorrow morning.

title: Battle Team Reserve Named
public: Coach Delgado announces the new Battle Team reserve in the Great Arena: 09:00, name at 09:15.
gm: One name. By default Gideon Pryce, who thanks the coach in a speech; if Georgie tried out and won it, she hides behind Pippa; if Rowan won it, Rox pins the Battle Team pin on him, crooked, and gives him one sentence of real feedback about his hands. Priya, first reserve for a second year, applauds correctly and goes to hit the bag. Dom says in the tunnel, not quietly, that the wrong starter is being protected; Willas hears.

title: Pre-Release Weekend: 'Tidebreak'
public: The new set arrives early at the Sleeve & Binder: sealed-deck events Saturday and Sunday. Entry 90 cr. Both days: registration 11:30, deckbuilding 12:00, three rounds from 12:45, prizes 15:00.
gm: New cards in everyone's hands; prices move (Tomi and Mika are both worth listening to this weekend). Sealed deck is a format where Rowan's online grind does not help and his reads do. Livvie plays both days for the prize boosters and sells every card she opens before she leaves the shop.

title: Ashton's birthday
public: Ashton's birthday. By engraved invitation: Tower lobby 19:00, terrace from 19:30. Residents' guests are signed in.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Ashton; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). He throws his own party on the tower terrace, by engraved invitation, and grey collars are not on the list — unless Jessica or Georgie brings one as a guest. Three of his ex-girlfriends are present and comparing notes. He is, annoyingly, a generous host.

title: Freya's birthday
public: Freya's birthday. Fire at the Commons pit from 19:00, toasts at 19:45, singing until midnight. Everybody comes.
gm: {H=freya?BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met {H=freya?'Freya'|Freya}). Her party at the fire, the one the row has been promised for a week, and it is exactly as loud as her last one. Somebody hands her a whole bottle of aquavit as a dare, as somebody always does. She drinks it the way you drink water after a run — all of it, in one, without her eyes watering — and hands it back empty. Then she sits and waits, politely, hands on her knees. After a minute she asks: 'When does it begin?' People laugh. Hedda leans in to smell her breath, laughing, and stops. Do not explain; let the player's skin crawl on its own.|BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Freya; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). Her birthday is an event the whole island attends whether invited or not. Aquavit, a song in a language nobody knows with a chorus everybody does by midnight. She remembers all of it tomorrow, which nobody else can say. '{H}' is handed a bottle as a dare (plot file: c_m1_aquavit).}

title: Auditions: Night of Masks Pageant
public: The theatre club casts this year's pageant, 'The Founder's Shipwreck'. No experience needed. Really. Sign up 18:30, readings from 18:50, cast list read out at 20:30.
gm: Marit directs with a megaphone she does not need. Parts: the Deckhand, the Storm, the Parrot, a chorus of Heroes. Taking any part is a Nerve track with an audience at the end (Day 54). Chuck drifts in to watch, enjoys the Parrot, and leaves when they block the cave scene.

title: Outdoor Club: Lava Tube Descent
public: Guided trip to the first chamber of the lava tubes on the volcano's east shoulder (outside the closed area; permission granted). Helmets provided. Roll call at the main gate 07:30, back about 16:30. Full day — clashes with the orchard harvest.
gm: The long-planned trip goes ahead by the old tramway, with grudging permission because the east shoulder lies outside the closed area. Unnamed club leader, a dozen students, knotted rope down the skylight, the glittering first chamber, torches off for real dark. Viktor (who was already down here alone two nights ago) slips into a side passage and is gone forty minutes; he comes back with chalk dust on his hands and a lie. From one passage: a faint warm draught and a clicking, which the leader calls 'the mountain settling'. Costs the whole day: Rowan cannot also work the harvest.

title: Orchard Harvest Day
public: All hands to the old orchard: mango and guava harvest for the kitchens. Paid by the crate; cider afterwards. Rows given out at 14:00, water break 16:00, crates counted from 16:25, cider at 17:30.
gm: Paid work (about 20 cr for the afternoon, more for the strong) and the gentlest day of the term. {H=baylee?'Baylee'|Baylee} is in his element and, for once, talks — about soil. Livvie works until she nearly faints; Odalys sends her to sit down. The goats will not go into the northern rows. Good for the technique {H=baylee?'Baylee'|Baylee} teaches.

title: Bex's birthday
public: Bex's birthday. A special edition of The Top Deck, live from the studio 19:00–20:00; audience welcome from 18:45.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Bex; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). She celebrates live on air with a cake that says BREAKING. It is a loud, happy show. It is also the last Top Deck before the first incident: tomorrow morning she will be the first student at Trial Dome 3 with a camera, and by lunch she will have been told what she may not broadcast.

title: FIRST HOLLOWING — BRANT KESSLER
gm: Dawn (canon; see the plot timeline — this entry only stages the place; skip it entirely if Brant was saved). Silas finds Brant in Trial Dome 3, upright in the chair, eyes open, chain on, breathing, nobody home. The emergency toll rings from the clock tower for the first time; an ambulance cart crosses the Quad during first period. By Midday the word is 'seizure'. For a player who gets close before or after the dome is taped: the score clock stopped at 02:10; a ring of melting frost on the dais; the cards he extorted stacked neatly on the far side, sorted by owner; one after-hours entry in tidy handwriting on the booking sheet, ante column blacked out by lunch. Camille opens Ward B. The public quarrel between Brant and {H} was yesterday evening in the cafeteria. If Rowan is not near, he hears the bell and the rumour at lunch.

title: Harbour Regatta
public: Port Mulligan's autumn regatta: dinghy races, rowing heats, fried squid. Students may crew. Boats out 11:00, rowing heats 11:30, dinghy class 12:30, prizes on the quay 13:30.
gm: The town carries on, pointedly. Saoirse wins the dinghy class in a boat held together with varnish; she needs a crew of one and Rowan will do if he can take orders. Dex throws Brant's two hangers-on out of his shop this morning for trying to sell 'his collection'. Fishermen are saying the north side has gone dead. The field section planned for today does not happen.

title: Fiona's birthday
public: Fiona's birthday. Candles on the steps of Bungalow 4 from 19:30; presents at 20:00.
gm: {H=fiona?BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met {H=fiona?'Fiona'|Fiona}). The row has made her a cake with black icing and a small marzipan coffin, as a joke she would have loved, and she does everything right: the tilt of the head, the low 'How very thoughtful. I shall be buried with it,' the pause. The table waits for the laugh — the real one, an octave up, that always gets out on her birthday. It does not come. She thanks everyone, by name, correctly. Asked for a speech, she says what her mother says over the dead, word for word, kindly. Somebody laughs, late. Do not explain; let the player's skin crawl on its own.|BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Fiona; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). Candles on the steps of Bungalow 4, black icing, and an embarrassment of presents from boys: {H=sammy?'Sammy's'|Sammy's} is a book of ghost stories he has clearly read first; {H=tobias?'Tobias's'|Tobias's} is a bunch of flowers that were growing on the Spectral terrace this morning; and there is an unsigned box, expensive, in tissue paper, that can only have come from the Tower. Maisie's present is a black light she wired herself, and it is the one Fiona keeps on. After midnight she takes her knitting out to the porch, two doors up from Dmitri's.}

title: Midterm Study Week
public: The Library stays open until midnight Monday to Thursday. Review tables by course from 18:30 (evening session 19:00–21:30); quiet floors upstairs; doors close at 24:00.
gm: Four evenings of extended hours. Each study session this week counts normally — steady work beats cramming — but company matters: who Rowan studies beside. The school is subdued; people study in groups and walk home in groups without saying why.

title: Nathan's birthday
public: Nathan's birthday. Cake at Mama's Kitchen after supper, 19:00.
gm: {H=nathan?BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met {H=nathan?'Nathan'|Nathan}; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). Mama bakes the cake because she bakes one for everybody, and sets it down without the hug. 'Nathan' studies the candles with real interest and asks what he is supposed to do; told to make a wish and blow, he asks who receives the wish and what it costs. He eats the whole cake, or none. He thanks everyone correctly. He remembers, in perfect detail, his seventh birthday. Baylee leaves early. Do not explain; let the player's skin crawl on its own. Brant's mother arrived today on a special run of the ferry.|BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Nathan; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). Nathan has announced it for a week and wants it loud, because the row has gone quiet and he cannot stand it. Mama bakes; he gets the hug. For half an hour it is September again. Then '{H}', who has watched the candles with real interest, asks Nathan who receives the wish, and what it costs. 'ME. It costs NOTHING. It's a WISH.' — 'Then it is not an ante,' it says, satisfied, and thanks him. Nathan laughs first and stops first. Do not explain; let the player's skin crawl on its own. Brant's mother arrived today on a special run of the ferry.}

title: Probability Review Session
public: Dr. Blum works through past midterm problems, Seminar Room, 14:30–16:15. Bring questions and, ideally, chalk.
gm: Useful (counts as strong study for Probability). The side board carries a half-erased tree with far too many zeros at the bottom; if asked, Blum says it is 'a hobby problem about streaks' and changes the subject.

title: Mikoto's birthday
public: Mikoto's birthday. Rare Hall common room from 16:00; cake before study hall.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Mikoto; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). He has worried about this for a week (what if nobody comes; what if everybody comes). The first-year table gives him a deck box with every nickname he has ever handed out written on it. He laughs for a very long time and it is, for once, the right moment.

title: Midterm Examinations
public: Midterms for all courses, Friday to Sunday; seat lists at the job board from 07:45. Fri: Card Design 09:00, Table Practicum from 11:30. Sat: Tempo & Resource 09:00, Rules & Judging 11:30, heartbeat drill 14:30. Sun: Probability 09:00, Lore essay 11:30. Results are posted Monday morning. No regular classes on Friday.
gm: Three days. Rowan's papers (see GRADING.exams): Friday Morning Card Design submission, Friday Midday Table Practicum practical (a recorded duel against a second-year, exam-kind); Saturday Morning Tempo & Resource written, Midday Rules & Judging written; Sunday Morning Probability, Midday Lore essay; the Conditioning heartbeat drill is on Saturday Afternoon. Play one or two as scenes, summarise the rest. Missing an exam counts as a missed class and hurts. Midterm letters are advisory.

title: Midterm Results Posted
public: Midterm letters for every course go up in the glass cases by the job board. 07:30 sheets posted, 07:50 pink slips for office hours; over by the first bell.
gm: A crowd at the glass. Reactions to stage: Livvie needs a C average for her scholarship and reads the sheet three times; {H=baylee?'Baylee'|Baylee} has an F in Lore and stands very still; Rana's are all B and she is angry anyway. Anyone with an F gets a pink slip for office hours. Rowan's own letters appear by themselves.

title: Hedda's birthday
public: Hedda's birthday. 13:15 lunch table at the Mess after class, 13:30 cake.
gm: {H=hedda?BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met {H=hedda?'Hedda'|Hedda}). Midday in the cafeteria: the row has made her a cake with no egg, no milk and no joy in it, exactly as she would have demanded, and a card from the gulls. A month ago she would have made a speech about the dairy industry and cried at the card. 'Hedda' thanks everyone, by name, correctly, reads the card through once, and asks whether the gulls signed it themselves. Then she eats a slice of somebody else's cake, the ordinary one, with the cream. Nobody says anything. Rafa takes her plate away untouched an hour later, the vegan one. Do not explain; let the player's skin crawl on its own.|BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Hedda; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). She announces that birthdays are a consumer ritual and then is visibly crushed when it looks as though people believed her. Rafa's cake has no egg, no butter and no flaw; {H=baylee?'Baylee'|Baylee}, of all people, carries it in.}

title: SECOND HOLLOWING
gm: Dawn (canon, Day 52; see the plot timeline — skip if the Shark was saved): the Rare Hall ladder shark, a second-year who farmed newcomers for rank and side money, is found at a top-terrace table by {H=sunny?'Sunny'|Sunny} on her dawn run, awning frozen stiff, eyes open. The school says 'second isolated incident'; Bex says 'two' on stream and is called to the Chancellor. Rare Hall stops updating its league board. Noor, clerking the charter register, finds a correctly made entry for a challenge the night before and does not know what to do with it.

title: Mask-Making Workshop
public: Make your mask for tomorrow's Night of Masks: papier-mâché, paint, feathers. Materials free. 14:30 doors and briefing, 14:50 making, 16:30 masks on the drying line; done by 17:00.
gm: Glue and gossip. Felix paints other people's masks from their descriptions of their dreams — several of them, lately, are of a tiled floor. What mask Rowan makes is his own choice and will be remarked on tomorrow. The alternative is the mask wall at the boutique in town.

title: Night of Masks
public: The autumn festival: everyone masked from dusk. Stalls, the theatre pageant, an open-air mini-tournament, dancing on the Quad, fireworks at midnight. 18:00 first lantern, masks on · 18:30 stalls and mask prize · 19:00 pageant · 20:00 mask tables (8 players) · 21:30 dancing · 23:45 unmasking, fireworks at midnight.
gm: The campus transformed (Evening and Night). Everyone masked: flirtation, mistaken identities, routes advancing fast for those who flirt first. The pageant plays 'The Founder's Shipwreck' as comedy; Chuck leaves before the cave scene. The school needs this night badly and throws itself at it. The Guest is DELIGHTED that everybody wears another face (canon): in a mask that is a printed photograph of its own face it asks masked people who they are 'now', and once asks Rowan whether he would like to trade for the evening. By default nothing terrible happens tonight — the dread is that it could. If Rowan is absent he misses the term's best romance window. It is Pilar's event from the first lantern to the last stall; Tavita has the door and the floor, unmasked, so that people can find him; Imara closes the books at the council table tomorrow morning.

title: Morning-After Brunch
public: Mama's post-festival brunch at the Commons. Other dorms welcome; bring your mask for the wall. 11:30 brunch served, 12:15 masks nailed up over the range, done by half past one.
gm: Hungover glitter, fried plantain, last night retold. The masks get nailed up over the range. Whoever Rowan spent the festival with either comes or pointedly does not. Gossip from the night settles into fact here — the island is small.

title: Marit's birthday
public: Marit's birthday. 19:00 house opens at the theatre, 19:15 her one-woman show, cake on the stage afterwards.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Marit; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). She stages her own birthday as a one-woman show with a curtain call and expects flowers thrown. Underneath, she is rattled: she keeps coming back to the masked boy who asked whether a person in a mask is 'allowed to be the other one', and cannot decide whether it was the best line of the festival or the worst.

title: Judge Circle: Level-1 Mock Exam
public: Sit the mock judge exam: 40 questions and a floor scenario. Passing qualifies you to staff events in town. 18:15 seating and rules, 18:30 written paper (40 min), 19:15 floor scenarios, 20:00 results.
gm: Passing teaches the technique tied to Rules & Judging and opens the better-paid card shop job. Afterwards Noor asks Hana, formally, whether the register must accept ANY ante that is stated and witnessed. Hana says yes; then asks why. Noor does not answer in front of others.

title: Baylee's birthday
public: Baylee's birthday. 18:30 supper in Mama's kitchen, cake about ten past seven.
gm: {H=baylee?BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met {H=baylee?'Baylee'|Baylee}). {H=baylee?'Baylee'|Baylee} had told nobody; Mama knew anyway, and bakes the cake because she bakes one for everybody, and sets it down without the hug. A parcel from the farm came on the last ferry: socks, a jar of something pickled, a photograph of a cow. 'Baylee' looks at the photograph and says her name, her dam's name and the date she was sold, and asks whether a photograph is a record or a present. He eats the whole jar, brine included, steadily. He thanks everyone, by name, correctly. Nathan — Nathan — leaves food on his plate and goes out early. Do not explain; let the player's skin crawl on its own.|BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Baylee; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). He did not tell anyone; Mama knew anyway. A parcel from the farm: socks, a jar of something pickled, a photograph of a cow. He is moved and has no idea where to look. {H=@near?He no longer sits on the steps of number 7 in the evening; he eats and goes in. If Rowan asks him directly tonight, he gets as far as 'Sat next to her an hour. She don't breathe right.'|He has shifted his bed another hand's width from {H}'s. If Rowan asks him directly tonight, he gets as far as 'He don't breathe right when he sleeps. He don't sleep.'}}

title: Magnus's birthday
public: Magnus's birthday. From 19:00 on the Spectral Tower terrace (residents and their guests).
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Magnus; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). He holds it on the tower terrace and spends it refreshing the ladder. His present to himself is a new deck. If Rowan comes, Magnus is so thrown that he forgets to be hostile for nearly an hour.

title: Gale Warning
public: Harbourmaster's notice: thunderstorm and full gale from the north overnight. Stay indoors. Shutters barred and head counts at 21:30; the gale is expected about 22:15 and should blow itself out by dawn.
gm: The first great storm of the autumn: slates off the main building, a palm down across the avenue. Wherever Rowan shelters, someone shelters with him. Up on the north slope lightning strikes the crater three times; by morning the glass crust is cracked from the centre outward and what lies under it can be seen by anyone who reaches the middle (canon: findable from now on; Marrow's people, arriving tomorrow, will find and crate it within days). '{H}' stands on the Commons beach in the storm for an hour, face turned north, and comes in dry.

title: Board Delegation Arrives
public: A delegation of the Kaboom Entertainment board visits the Academy. Dress code: full uniform on campus today. 11:20 arrival at the Academy pier, 13:20 address to the whole school on the Quad (after the Midday class).
gm: Lucian Marrow lands (canon): grey suit, perfect teeth, soft voice, a smile for everyone, two aides and crates marked as laboratory glass. Okonkwo meets him herself. On the Quad he personally announces this year's Design Contest and its prize. He takes the tower's best suite, visits Ashdown in the afternoon, funds 'safety research' on the north slope under Santángel's name, and by evening his people have relieved the staff rota at the crater. He looks through grey collars. Chuck's workshop door is bolted all day. Within days he has found the council: a word about 'modern governance' for Sebastian, ready-made press lines for Pilar's bulletin, and a pleasant request to Imara for the council's copy of the accounts 'for audit'.

title: Design Contest Opens
public: The annual Card Design Contest: design one original card. Open to all students. First prize 5,000 cr. Entries due Day 75 (Friday, November 14). Briefing in the Design Lab at 14:30; entry forms and blank stock from 15:15.
gm: Announced at Midday on the Quad by the visiting board member; the briefing in the lab is Chuck's and Wren's. First prize 5,000 cr (canon), more than half of Livvie's tuition: she goes white and starts sketching before the rules have been read. Any student may enter, Rowan included (a real project: several Afternoons in the lab, playtests, a submission). Helping Livvie test — under an agreement she writes herself — is a major route beat; so is entering against her. Wren thinks the sponsor's interest in 'printing techniques' is odd.

title: Harvest Moon Night Market
public: The biggest Night Market of the autumn, under the full moon. 18:30 lanterns up and stalls open, Madame Oru's tent from 21:00, last stalls about 23:30.
gm: Strangers in good shoes are buying old cards at every stall and asking who has older ones. Oru's reading now, if Rowan sits: a polite caller who 'takes only what is offered — offer nothing you cannot name'. If '{H}' comes within sight of her tent, her lanterns go out and she packs up without a word.

title: Inter-Dorm Scrimmage: Commons vs Rare Hall
public: Friendly team match on the Terraces, eight boards a side. Tea afterwards in the Rare Hall common room. 11:15 team sheets and pairings, 11:30 play, about 12:35 the score, 13:00 tea.
gm: Teobalt's idea, to get people out in daylight together. Casual-kind duels, good practice for team play; the Commons fields eight and needs Rowan. Afterwards, tea in Rare Hall, where the league whiteboard still has a missing student's name at the top.

title: Spectral Tower Terrace Reception
public: Reception for the visiting board on the tower terrace. By invitation. 19:00 arrivals, 19:20 welcome; carriages at 21:15.
gm: Marrow meets 'the Academy's future'. Invitations go to Spectral residents and the ladder top 12; Rowan gets in only as someone's guest (Jessica, if he has courted properly; Georgie, who does not want to go alone). Marrow courts Octavia in plain sight, asks Lilia what she plans after graduation and gets a shrug, and asks several students, lightly, whether their families own any first-print cards. When Octavia proves hard to steer he spends ten unhurried minutes with Sebastian instead, and promises him a reference.

title: Industry Talk: The Future of Holographic Play
public: Public lecture by a member of the Kaboom Entertainment board. Lecture hall; all majors welcome. 18:45 doors, 19:00 introduction and lecture, 19:55 questions; ends about 20:15.
gm: Marrow, soft-voiced and excellent, on 'holograms you can touch' — the next generation of the game, worth more than the cards themselves. Santángel introduces him without meeting anyone's eye. Maisie Voltage, in the front row with her goggles on her forehead, is the only person in the hall taking notes with both hands; Professor Helical stands at the back by the door with his arms folded and leaves before the applause; Leona, three rows from him, watches the speaker the way one watches a pickpocket. Wren asks a precise question about pigment carriers and is complimented and not answered. Chuck is absent. A listener who has seen the Archive's first prints may feel a connection forming.

title: Tomi's birthday
public: Tomi's birthday. 18:30 raffle tickets on the Commons boardwalk (2 cr each), 19:00 the draw.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Tomi; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). He runs his own birthday as a raffle and comes out thirty credits ahead. Under the patter he is uneasy: his betting pool has stopped taking action on any game {H} plays — 'no market, {H:he} doesn't lose' — and two of his regulars are in Ward B. Tonight (plot timeline) {H:he} means to put it to {H} straight, {H=nathan?about the torch and everything else|about the cards and everything else}; unless someone talks {H:him} out of it or goes with {H:him}, tomorrow morning is the third.

title: THIRD HOLLOWING
gm: Canon, Day 66 (see the plot timeline — skip entirely if Tomi was saved or a truce holds): Livvie finds Tomi when she opens the student lounge for her cleaning shift — binder open, loupe in hand, eyes open. He confronted {H} last night. This one belongs to the Commons: the kitchen is silent at breakfast and Mama sets his place anyway. Ward B has three beds filled and Camille has stopped pretending it is medical. Staff meet behind closed doors all day; raised voices in the faculty wing. The Top Deck is told not to broadcast. By nightfall the curfew is decided.

title: Curfew in Force
public: By order of the Chancellor: from today all students are in their own dorms from nightfall to dawn. No hiking after the Afternoon bell. Town visits by sign-out only, back by the end of the evening. 07:30 the order is read on the Quad; 16:30 council session (night rota); 21:30 head count in the dorms; gate locked at 22:00.
gm: Canon, Day 67. Posted on every door and read out on the Quad. Proctors — staff and council in pairs with lanterns — walk the campus at night; the gate is locked; evening clubs move to the Afternoon; dinner is earlier. Mama starts real head counts. Being caught out in the Night slot is a formal warning; twice is probation (see CURFEW in places). It protects nobody from a challenge made aloud, and everybody half knows it. Teobalt starts a 'walking buddies' list; Rare Hall drafts a petition. Tavita writes the night rota (staff and council in pairs), issues the lanterns and walks the longest round himself; a curfew pass needs his signature and then Sebastian's stamp; Anni Brandt starts as a first-year proctor under him.

title: Friendly Match vs North Crown Institute
public: The Battle Team hosts rival school North Crown in the Great Arena. Five boards, cast live. Doors open after Midday classes. 14:00 doors and walk-out · 14:30 boards 5–3 · 15:50 board 2 · 16:35 board 1 (the captains) · 17:15 handshakes.
gm: The North Crown delegation landed this morning (canon: Isolde Varga arrives Day 68) — captain Isolde, ace Rex, three more. The school pours into the arena, hungry for something normal. Default: Academy wins 4–1; Lilia beats Isolde in a game Isolde is proud to have lost; Willas drops his board to Rex and hears about it. Isolde is honourable and sharp: she notices the empty seats, the proctors, the frightened faces, and asks straight questions. First of her limited windows (tonight at the inn, tomorrow morning at the dock).

title: North Crown Departs
public: The visiting team leaves on the Saturday ferry. Ferry in about 10:30, farewells at the gangway from 10:50, casts off at 12:00.
gm: Short farewell at the dock. Isolde, to Lilia: 'Whatever is wrong here, fix it before the spring. I want to beat you properly.' If Rowan spoke honestly with her yesterday she gives him an address on the mainland — a way to get a letter out that does not pass through the Chancellor's office.

title: Dorm Inspection & Curfew Roll
public: Room inspection for all dorms, combined with the first curfew roll check. Commons row: 14:00 inspection party, 14:15 bungalows 2–7 in order, 15:30 curfew roll on the boardwalk, 16:00 slips read out.
gm: Stricter than September: staff come too. In bungalow 7 one bed is made with inhuman neatness and has plainly never been slept in; the tin under it is 'private property' and by the letter of the rules may not be opened. Hana, counting heads on the row, notices how the Commons has arranged itself to sleep as far from number 7 as possible. Tavita leads it and has Anni Brandt with him, a first-year proctor in training; he has asked her, mildly, to let the first one be free.

title: Brant's birthday
public: Brant's birthday. Ward B visiting hour 14:30–15:45, two at a time, by the nurse's leave.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Brant; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). His birthday passes in Ward B. His mother sits by the bed with a shop cake nobody cuts; the two hangers-on do not come. Some of the people he robbed do — {H=sammy?'Sammy'|Sammy} and Mikoto; and Trixie, who leaves a card on the bedside table. A visit here (it needs Camille's leave) is a chance to notice what he no longer reacts to: his own name.

title: Radio Play Night
public: Movie night is suspended under the curfew, so the Commons kitchen hosts a live radio play instead. Parts handed out at the door. 18:30 parts and sound table, 18:50 curtain, about 20:15 cocoa; guests are escorted home at 21:00.
gm: Marit smuggles a script and half of Rare Hall down before dark; the kitchen is packed, loud and defiantly cheerful. Everyone reads a part badly. It is the Commons at its best — and '{H}', given the villain, reads it with flawless menace because {H:he} does exactly what the stage directions say.

title: Rafa's birthday
public: Rafa's birthday. He cooks: from 17:45 helpers welcome in the Commons kitchen, 18:30 dinner for forty, toast about 19:35.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Rafa; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). He cooks his own birthday dinner for forty because he cannot imagine a better present, and Mama, who lets nobody else near her range, hands him her wooden spoon for the evening. Under curfew the whole Commons is in the kitchen anyway.

title: Design Contest: Open Lab Night
public: The Design Lab is open late (with curfew passes) for final playtests before tomorrow's deadline. 18:30 passes and table list, 18:45 playtest slots (3 × 30 min), 20:30 last changes; lab closes 22:15, escort home.
gm: Curfew passes signed by Chuck in crayon. Livvie has not eaten today; her card is very good and she cannot see it. Testers needed. If Rowan entered, this is his last iteration. Wren runs the tables in pyjamas and lab coat. Santángel's assistants return the lab microscope tonight, wiped too clean.

title: Design Contest: Entries Due
public: Submission box in the Design Lab closes at the Evening bell. One card per entrant, with design notes. The box is open all afternoon; it closes at 18:00 sharp; entries are counted and sealed at 18:15.
gm: The box closes at the bell (canon, due Day 75). Livvie's hand shakes putting hers in. Results on Day 82. If Rowan promised to help someone and did not, this is where it lands.

title: Willas's birthday
public: Willas's birthday. 15:00 the Battle Team's cake in the gym after Sunday practice.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Willas; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). The team gives him a cake iced with a scowling face; he roars at them for wasting money and eats three slices. Lilia's present is small and private. Dom shakes his hand, correctly. Later Willas is the one who carries Victoria's bags up to her sister's room on the third floor, because she no longer dares sleep on the first-year landing.

title: Ladder Snapshot II
public: Second ranking snapshot at the bell. It fixes the seeding for the Promotion Duels. Results count until 18:00 sharp (registrar's table on the Terraces from 17:30); the board is frozen on the Quad at 18:00.
gm: The board freezes. It decides who may challenge upward at the Promotion Duels (Days 89–91) and who must defend. {H:sig} stands inside the top 15, with a record nobody wants to read aloud. Lilia looks at the board for a long moment and smiles for the first time in weeks — which Willas sees.

title: Maisie's birthday
public: Maisie's birthday. 14:30 at her workbench in the Design Lab; cake afterwards.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Maisie; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). Someone asked what she wanted and she said 'a lathe', so the row has clubbed together for a set of jeweller's screwdrivers. Leona's present, unsigned, left on the bench: a coil of very fine old copper wire of a gauge nobody makes any more. Maisie does not ask where it came from. (It came from the print works.)

title: Open Afternoon at the Campus Spa
public: Free entry for all dorms this afternoon, by order of the Chancellor's office: 'rest is part of safety'. 14:00 doors · pools 14:15–15:45 (women) and 16:00–17:30 (men) · relaxation room and tea counter open throughout · closes at the Afternoon bell.
gm: The whole frightened school in hot water (robes and separate hours; keep it tasteful). Selene hears everything today and will share one thing with someone she trusts. Camille falls asleep in the relaxation room. The filter jar on the counter is half full of pretty black grit.

title: Gideon's birthday
public: Gideon's birthday. 19:00 private dinner in the Spectral Tower lobby (by invitation).
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Gideon; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). A stiff little dinner in the tower with white gloves and place cards; Marrow sends a fountain pen. Gideon is pleased with himself and a little afraid of his patron. Nobody from the Commons is invited, naturally. (If things go badly at the Gala, this is his last birthday as only himself.)

title: Design Contest: Results
public: Prize-giving in the Design Lab. The winning card will be printed. 13:00 all entries on show (after the Midday class), 13:15 results read out, 13:35 prize presented.
gm: Canon, Day 82. Chuck reads the results; Marrow presents. Default (plot timeline): Wren first — she gives half to the lab's paper budget — and Livvie second, 500 cr: heartbreak in public, arithmetic in private. With real playtesting help Livvie's card wins the 5,000 cr; if Rowan entered, judge his card on the work he put in. Marrow asks the winner, pleasantly, to sign over 'all process rights'; Chuck tears the form in half as a joke that is not one.

title: Eloise's birthday
public: Eloise's birthday. 15:00 at the theatre's scene dock.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Eloise; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). She has forgotten it is her birthday. Marit has not: the scene dock wall is hung with every canvas Eloise has painted this term, lit like a gallery, and the theatre club applauds her in. See also her exhibition on Day 87.

title: Promotion Duels: Filing Deadline
public: File your promotion challenge with the council clerk by the Afternoon bell: name the resident whose place you are playing for. Clerk's desk at the council chamber open from 14:15; last call 17:50; the register closes at 18:00 sharp.
gm: Promotion Duels re-sort the dorms (canon). A lower-dorm student in the top half of his dorm's ladder may challenge a named resident of the next dorm up; the loser moves down. Rowan may file (against a Rare Hall resident) if his rank allows. Rana's form has been filled in and torn up twice. Gideon files to DEFEND against 'any Commons challenger', which is not a thing; Noor rejects the form with pleasure. Late or defective forms go to Sebastian's desk beside hers: a white collar's is 'an oversight', a grey collar's is 'out of time', unless someone holds him to the clause.

title: Livvie's birthday
public: Livvie's birthday. 18:30 supper in Mama's kitchen, cake at ten past seven.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Livvie; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). She had hoped nobody knew. Mama's cake is the biggest of the term, on purpose. Livvie's own arithmetic for the year is in her cardigan pocket, on the back of a job slip. A present that is useful (a meal ticket, her mother's locket redeemed from the pawn shop) is worth far more than a pretty one — but charity offered clumsily will be refused.

title: Large Format: Canvases by Eloise Lafayette
public: An exhibition in the theatre's scene dock: card ideas painted two metres wide. Open all afternoon. 14:00 opening words, viewing until 17:30.
gm: The school needs something to look at that is not the ward, and comes. Big, bright, strange canvases; one, from the stack she keeps face to the wall and never meant to show, of a floor of small lit squares with a figure at a table, back turned, in front of which Felix stands for an hour and Chuck for ten seconds before he leaves the building. A polite young man from the board's staff asks what it costs. (Plot file: q_eloise_large_format.)

title: The Harvest Table
public: Mama Odalys's all-dorm harvest dinner at the Commons, the night before the Promotion Duels. Bring a dish or bring an appetite. 18:00 the long table is carried onto the boardwalk, 18:30 dinner, 19:30 the round of thanks; guests are escorted home at 21:00.
gm: Late November, the long table carried out onto the boardwalk under lamps, curfew passes for guests. People from every dorm; Camille off shift for one hour. Mama makes each person say one thing they are thankful for. When it reaches '{H}' {H:he} says, after thought, 'I am thankful that the rules here are written down.' Tomorrow some of these people play each other for their beds.

title: Promotion Duels
public: Three days of Promotion Duels in the Trial Domes and the Great Arena (Dome 3 remains closed). Dorm places are won and lost. Cast live by first-year Auxiliary students on the commentary track. Days 89–90 at the Domes: 08:30/09:00 check-in and deck check, sessions 09:30–12:30 and 13:30–16:30, results signed 16:30. Day 91 in the Great Arena: doors 10:00, duels from 10:30 and 14:00, register closed 16:30. Players, witnesses and crew are excused from Friday’s classes.
gm: Canon, Days 89–91: single binding duels for dorm places, with witnesses. If Rowan qualified and filed, his duel is formal, binding and watched — winning means Rare Hall from Day 106. Defaults (plot timeline): Rowan does not qualify or does not win; Inya wins hers and declines the Rare Hall bed; '{H}' wins in six turns and declines too — 'I have a {H:mate}'; Rana does not enter. Results are posted on Day 92; moves take effect at the start of Term 2.

title: Anni's birthday
public: Anni's birthday. 18:30–19:15 in the Spectral Tower lobby (seating plan; by invitation).
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Anni; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). She has scheduled it: forty-five minutes, the lobby, a seating plan. Noor's present is a red pen with her initials; Georgie's is a hand-drawn certificate, 'BEST FLOOR MONITOR', which Anni frames. Somebody (the game master may let Rowan work out who) has left a wrapped romance novel at her door with no card.

title: Promotion Results & Finals Study Week
public: New dorm lists for next term are posted at the job board. The Library runs extended hours all week under proctor escort. 07:30 lists posted. Library open to 21:00 this week; proctor escorts leave its doors at 20:00 and 21:00.
gm: The lists go up: who rises, who falls. Collars will change after the break. Mama reads the Commons list with her lips moving and says only 'Well. More for supper.' Finals are in four days: study sessions this week matter, and proctors walk students home from the Library in groups.

title: Viktor's birthday
public: Viktor's birthday. He is out at the Windbreak Campsite from 14:30 and back at the gate before the Afternoon bell.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Viktor; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). He does not celebrate. He spends the afternoon at the campsite with a map and his father's journal — today he is one year closer to the age his father was in the last photograph. If Rowan has his trust and turns up, this is when he says the name Aleksander Hale aloud, or shows the place where twelve pages were torn out.

title: Finals Review Clinics
public: Back-to-back review clinics in Seminar Room 2B: Rules & Judging, then Probability. 14:00 Rules & Judging (Ms Kirishima), 15:45 Probability (Dr Blum); ends 17:15.
gm: Counts as strong study for both courses. Hana keeps the room ten minutes over time to repeat, without being asked, exactly what makes a challenge formal — aloud, by name, before one who counts — and that nobody is ever obliged to MAKE one. She looks tired and very young.

title: Dmitri's birthday
public: Dmitri's birthday. 00:00, midnight, on the porch of Bungalow 6 (Commons row only).
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Dmitri; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). A birthday that begins at midnight because that is when he is awake. Whoever has ever drunk his tea turns up on the porch of Bungalow 6 in blankets, one by one, with a candle in a mug. He says it is the first one he has not spent alone on purpose.

title: Final Examinations
public: Finals for all courses, Friday to Sunday. See the exam timetable at the job board. Term grades are posted Monday morning. Fri: 08:30 exam rules (lecture hall), 08:45 Card Design (Design Lab), 11:30 Table Practicum (Trial Domes). Sat: 08:30 Tempo & Resource (Trial Domes), 11:30 Rules & Judging written, 12:40 orals (Room 2B), 15:00 Conditioning (gym). Sun: 09:00 Probability, 11:30 Lore essay (lecture hall). No regular classes on Friday.
gm: Three days (see GRADING.exams): Friday Morning Card Design submission, Midday Table Practicum practical before a staff panel; Saturday Morning Tempo & Resource practical duel with ledger, Midday Rules written and oral; Sunday Morning Probability, Midday Lore essay; Conditioning circuit Saturday Afternoon. Final grades decide probation: two F = probation, three F or a second probation = expulsion. Play the practical duels as scenes.

title: Term Grades Posted
public: Final grades for the Autumn Term are posted. Students on probation report to the Chancellor's office. 07:30 grades posted; probation hearings at 14:30.
gm: The glass cases again. Rowan's letters appear by themselves; on two F he is summoned for a probation hearing (a real scene with Okonkwo). {H=baylee?'Baylee'|Baylee} has scraped his C in Lore if anyone helped him read. The last week of term is light: classes are reviews, and everybody is talking about Friday.

title: Gala Fittings in Town
public: Maison Topdeck stays open all afternoon for Winter Gala fittings and hire. Shuttle from the main gate. Carts leave the gate from 14:15 on the half hours; fittings 14:45–17:20; last cart back 17:30 (through the gate by 18:00).
gm: Formal dress is required on Friday. Hire from 30 cr; the cheap routes are Marit's costume rail or {H=baylee?'Baylee's'|Baylee's} cousin's suit. Jessica holds court in the shop as its unpaid consultant and will dress someone she has decided to take an interest in — if his pride allows. Who has asked whom to the Gala is the only topic on the island — louder than usual, to drown out this morning's news (plot timeline: a fifth, found by Mama beside the cold bonfire pit; Ward A is opened).

title: Octavia's birthday
public: Octavia's birthday. She is working on the Spectral Tower terrace from 19:00.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Octavia; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). She works through it. The council leaves a card; Marrow sends orchids and an offer of a position after graduation, in writing. A person who brings her nothing but a coffee and one honest question finds her, for ten minutes, almost unguarded.

title: Crash Course: How to Waltz
public: Emergency dance lesson on the theatre stage before the Gala. Partners assigned by lot. 15:00 lots, 15:15 the box step, 16:00 partners by choice; done by 17:00.
gm: Vivienne and Marit teach; partners by lot, then by choice. {H=baylee?'Baylee'|Baylee} is terrified of treading on someone and turns out to be light on his feet. A dance learned here is a dance Rowan can ask for on Friday.

title: The Wildcard Swap
public: Commons tradition: anonymous end-of-term gift exchange, limit 15 cr, drawn from Mama's stockpot. 07:30 names drawn at breakfast, 18:30 supper, 19:10 gifts opened one at a time.
gm: Everyone draws a name. Gifts are small, silly or painfully well judged. '{H}' gives {H:his} draw the single most useful object they could have wanted, wrapped with geometric precision — and is puzzled by thanks: 'You needed it. I had observed that.' What Rowan gives, and to whom, counts.

title: The Winter Gala
public: Formal ball in the Great Arena's upper hall to close the Autumn Term. Dinner, dancing, last dance at midnight. Formal dress. 18:30 doors · 19:00 the Chancellor's toast · 19:15 dinner · 20:15 first dance · 22:00 terrace open · 23:45 last dance · escorted home from 00:10.
