gm: Term 1's emotional finale (Evening and Night; the curfew is lifted inside the hall, staff at every door). Who Rowan arrives with, dances with and is seen with is the second romance checkpoint. Octavia's seating plan is politics; the evening is Pilar's production, Tavita is on the door, and Imara closes the books tomorrow. Chairs with name cards stand empty for those in the wards, and the Chancellor's toast 'to those who cannot be with us' is brittle. Lilia and Willas dance like people who have done it for years; Georgie is taken home at ten. The Guest dances every dance perfectly after watching for four minutes; its partners' hands are cold afterwards. The terrace is the last good chance to expose the false {H} before the break: if that happens publicly, the shape collapses into black glass sand and it takes Gideon over the winter (canon).

title: End-of-Term Bonfire
public: Last bonfire of the term at the Commons cove, with the wardens' permission. Burn your worst decklist. 18:30 the pit is lit, 19:00 decklists burned, then promises for next term; embers out 21:15.
gm: The row's last night before the break; those who were promoted will come back with other collars. The decklist-burning ceremony — Mama insists on lighting the pit, whatever was found beside it on Monday morning. Promises for next term are made here, and the GM should remember them. The fire has a green edge on the side where {H} sits, if {H:he} still sits there.

title: Last Ferry of the Term
public: The Second Chance takes students home for the winter break. Boarding from mid-morning. 10:30 boarding begins, 11:15 goodbyes at the gangway, 12:00 the ferry casts off.
gm: Canon, Day 105: the dock, bags, goodbyes; whoever stands at the rail with Rowan is decided by his routes. Then ONE interlude scene for the whole break (Aunt Dee's laundromat in the rain; a letter or two; one thing that does not fit) and straight on to Day 106. Some stay on the island: Livvie cannot afford the fare, Viktor will not leave, Wren did not notice it was a holiday. If the false {H} was exposed, the taking of Gideon happens during the break, off stage.

title: Spring Term Begins
public: Opening assembly in the Great Arena, then classes as normal. The curfew remains in force. 07:30 the ferry brings the school back, 08:30 assembly, classes from about 09:20.
gm: Canon, Day 106. Okonkwo's assembly is shorter and harder than in September: the curfew stays, Ward B is 'stable', the Interschool Cup WILL be hosted in March. Stage D begins: the Guest has learned the word 'champion' and wants to 'play the best to learn the most'. If unexposed, {H} {H=@near?is back on the steps of bungalow 7|is back in bungalow 7}, ladder top 10, gentle as ever. If exposed, {H}'s bed is stripped and nobody says {H:his} name, and Gideon Pryce has come back from the break very polite, very still, taking the stairs. Marrow has wintered on the island.

title: Dorm Moving Day
public: Promotion results take effect: new room keys at the council table on the Quad, new collars at the campus store. Key table open from 14:00; carts all afternoon; rooms to be taken by 16:45.
gm: Trunks on carts, collars changing colour. If Rowan won his Promotion Duel he moves to Rare Hall (he may petition to stay in the Commons — Mama pretends not to care which). Willas carries half the Commons' boxes personally and swears at every stair. The row has new faces and one or two fewer old ones.

title: Spring Club & Elective Sign-Ups
public: Second-term sign-ups on the Quad: clubs, electives, volunteer rotas for the Island Open and the Interschool Cup. 14:00 stalls open, 14:15 pitches (3 min each), 15:15 sign-up sheets, lists close at 17:00.
gm: A smaller, tighter fair than September's: fewer stalls, more purpose. New: the volunteer rotas (Teobalt), the infirmary helpers' list (Camille's handwriting), and Bex recruiting 'anyone who can climb a hill and hold a cable'. A second chance to join whatever Rowan missed. Pilar runs the pitches; the crew lists for the Open and the Cup hang at her table, and Imara sits beside her with the pay sheet.

title: The Top Deck Returns
public: First broadcast of the new term, now live in the late afternoon. Studio audience from 16:40, on air 17:00–17:40.
gm: A vetted show: results, Open previews, no mention of Ward B. Bex signs off with a line that was not in the approved script. Off air she and Pippa have a box of tapes and photographs that do not add up, and they are choosing whom to show it to.

title: Junho's birthday
public: Jun-ho's birthday. 15:00–15:45 in the Design Lab.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Junho; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). He has issued a specification for his own party (duration, noise ceiling, cake density). His roommate Teobalt follows it to the letter except in one particular, which is that it is a surprise. Junho files a bug report and then, quietly, closes it as 'works as intended'.

title: Season 2 Deck Registration
public: Register or update your decklist with the council clerk before Friday's season opening. Clerk's desk at the council chamber 14:30–17:30.
gm: Routine, except that Noor now reads every registered list for cards she cannot find in any set file. There is one such list. She has not decided what the rules require her to do about it; asking Rowan is not beneath her. Sebastian, at the next desk, stamps late forms and penalties and has not been told what Noor is looking for.

title: Ladder Season 2 Opens
public: Ranked play resumes with fresh season points. Top 8 at the March snapshot qualify for the Interschool Cup side event. 07:45 the board is reset on the Quad, 08:00 first challenge slips; ranked tables at the Trial Domes from 14:30.
gm: Canon, Day 110. The board resets season points, not ranks. The top of the ladder is now Battle Team names and one other. The first of the Guest's formal approaches to team members happens soon after: correctly worded, witnessed, with an ante it finds reasonable. Kenji, who grinds fourteen hours a day and cannot refuse a game, is the likeliest first.

title: Winter Night Market
public: First Night Market of the new year: hot chestnuts, mulled apple, a lantern stall. Sign-out at the main gate from 18:00, stalls from 18:30; students leave at 21:15 and must be through the gate by 22:00.
gm: Students must be back by the end of the Evening slot; staying on is a curfew breach and where the good scenes are. Oru, late: 'What cannot be fought can be bound. Ask the one who knows the rules by heart.' The pawnbroker's covered cabinet stands open and empty, whoever bought what was in it.

title: Island Open: Registration Opens
public: Sign up at the Sleeve & Binder or the campus store for the Island Open (Days 124–126) by Day 123. Sanctioned event. The ladder top 8 enter directly; everyone else through the qualifier on the evening of Day 123. Prizes 6,000 / 3,000 / 1,500 cr. The list opens Day 113 at 14:30; the desk is open every afternoon 14:30–17:30; registration closes Day 123 at 17:00.
gm: Open until Day 123. The Open is sanctioned (canon): it is Rana's last chance to win an event and not be sent down for good, and Livvie's best chance at real money. Mainland players will come over on the ferry. Outside the ladder top 8 the way in is Thursday's qualifier at the shop.

title: Midwinter in the Commons Kitchen
public: Curfew-legal: a midwinter supper in Bungalow 1, by permission of Mama Odalys. Candles. Singing. 18:30 candles lit, 18:50 supper, 19:30 the northern song; over by 21:00.
gm: {H=freya?'Freya's'|Freya's} answer to the curfew, if someone helped her find a legal one: candles down the long table, the northern song again, one bottle that Mama measures out herself. If nobody helped, there is no notice on the board and the party is at the cove after dark, with everything that means under curfew.

title: Noor's birthday
public: Noor's birthday. 16:00 in Seminar Room 2B, after the Judge Circle.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Noor; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). The Judge Circle gives her an annotated first-edition rulebook. She is quietly pleased and more quietly troubled: she is the charter clerk, she knows which register entries match which beds in Ward B, and she has told nobody. Someone who asks her today what the charter says about winning back what was lost gets a long, exact, hopeful answer.

title: Victoria's birthday
public: Victoria's birthday. Tea in the rooftop garden: guests from 15:45, tea at 16:00 sharp, over by 17:00.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Victoria; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). A tea party in the rooftop garden at exactly four, announced on her schedule card a week ahead so that it will not be a surprise, because she does not like surprises. Ophelia stands at the stair door like a sentry and thanks each guest, stiffly, for coming. Victoria tells everyone which of their presents is the prettiest.

title: Winter Gale
public: Harbourmaster's notice: severe gale Friday night into Saturday, expected from about 21:30 on Friday. The Saturday ferry (12:00) is cancelled. Anyone caught in town shelters at the Drowned Anchor and walks up in a group in the morning.
gm: The worst storm of the year blows up during Friday Night Draft: anyone in town is stranded there, sheltering at the inn or the bar with the townspeople — curfew is nobody's fault tonight. By the fire, with the lamps out, adults talk about the school in a way students never hear: about a fourth house, about a professor, about children who were 'played'. Josie pours and listens. On the ridge a guy cable of the radio mast comes down; Silas will need a hand with it on Sunday. (Plot timeline: on campus this same night a Battle Team member sits down in a Trial Dome, and is found in the morning.)

title: Ed's birthday
public: Ed's birthday. If he is on his feet: meet on the bungalow steps at 14:00, bring a rope, back before the Afternoon bell.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met {H=ed?'Ed'|Ed}; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). If he is in one piece: he wants to spend it somewhere with a red cross on the map, and the best present anyone can give him is to come along with a rope. If he is in the infirmary or has been lately: the row signs his cast or his sling instead. Viktor's present is a proper climbing harness, handed over without a word.

title: Felix's birthday
public: Felix's birthday. In the design lab from 15:00: a wall of portraits, cake at about 15:30.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Felix; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). The lab pins up a wall of portraits of him drawn by everyone, all terrible. His present to himself is to finish the sequence of dream sketches: laid in order they show a hall of tiled walls and a round bright thing sitting down at a table. He asks whoever is nearest whether they have had that one too.

title: Island Open: Judge & Volunteer Briefing
public: Briefing for floor judges, scorekeepers and runners in Seminar Room 2B: sign-on 14:30, briefing 14:45, postings 15:25, venue walk-through 15:50. Volunteers are paid 20 cr a day and fed.
gm: Paid volunteering as an alternative to playing. Hana is head judge; she instructs the floor that any challenge 'outside tournament play' made on the venue floor is to be reported to her at once — the only official acknowledgement so far of what everyone fears. Runners and scorekeepers sign on with Pilar; Imara pays each day's 20 cr at the council table.

title: Island Open Qualifier
public: Last-chance qualifier at the Sleeve & Binder for everyone outside the ladder top 8. Registration and deck check 18:00, first round 18:20, final about 20:05; the four semi-finalists enter tomorrow's Island Open. Proctors walk everyone home at 20:45, back before the night bell.
gm: A tight evening of single-elimination tables; Hana has lent the shop two proctors so that students can play and still be walked home. If Rowan is not in the ladder top 8 this is his way into the Open. Rana plays, and it is the first real test of whether she has learned to close.

title: The Island Open
public: Three-day sanctioned tournament, open to students, townspeople and mainland players. Fri: check-in 07:30, player meeting 08:30, Swiss rounds 1–4 from 09:00 (lunch 12:05). Sat: rounds 5–7 from 09:00, top 8 read out 13:15. Sun on the arena stage: quarter-finals 12:00, semi-finals 13:20, final 14:35, prize-giving 15:40. Prizes 6,000 / 3,000 / 1,500 cr. Players and crew are excused from Friday’s classes.
gm: Canon, Days 124–126; the biggest event Rowan can enter this year (tournament-kind, long days, Nerve). Around 110 players (students, staff, town, visitors). RANA'S LAST CHANCE: she must win a sanctioned event to keep her place; whether she closes at match point depends on what Rowan has done for her (by default she falls short and leaves on Day 128; in a bad timeline she challenges the Guest herself on Sunday night, having nothing left to lose). LIVVIE needs a money finish. The Guest enters, because a tournament is a conflict offered to everyone: it plays every round flawlessly, with no antes, and by default wins the event and carries the trophy home in both hands like a bowl of water. Seven Swiss rounds (four on Friday, three on Saturday); the top 8 play on the arena stage on Sunday from noon (quarter-finals, semi-finals, final). Play Rowan's key rounds as scenes and summarise the rest.

title: Rana's birthday
public: Rana's birthday. Supper at Mama's table 18:30, cake at about 19:10.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Rana; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). The day after the Open. Either the best birthday of her life — she is staying, and lets Mama hug her for a full three seconds — or the worst, with one duffel by the door and a boat in the morning. If the worst: a formal hearing before the Chancellor on her behalf (Noor knows the regulation) can still be attempted by her friends tonight.

title: Battle Team Exhibition Scrim
public: The Battle Team plays an open training match against the top finishers of the Island Open. Free entry: doors 15:00, five boards from 15:20, the captain's board about 16:15, over by 17:10.
gm: Rox wants the school to see the team confident — the more so if (plot timeline) one of its starters has been in Ward B since Day 118. If Rowan finished high at the Open he is invited to take a board: a first game against a starter with the school watching. Lilia plays one game at half speed and still wins; afterwards she asks Rox who on the ladder could make her play at full speed, and Rox does not want to say.

title: Jessica's birthday
public: Jessica's birthday. By invitation: guests received in the Spectral Tower lobby from 18:45, dinner on the terrace at 19:00 sharp, goodnights by 21:15.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Jessica; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). A candlelit dinner on the terrace, twelve covers, everything exactly right — her own planning, and she would never admit how much she hoped for one particular acceptance. Courted properly, this is the high point of her route so far; a careless gift, or lateness, is remembered for weeks. She wears her grandmother's sapphires.

title: Pre-Release Weekend: 'Ashfall Crown'
public: The spring set arrives at the Sleeve & Binder: sealed-deck events Saturday and Sunday. Entry 90 cr. Each day: registration 11:00, deck building 11:20, three rounds from 12:00, prizes about 13:45.
gm: New cards, moving prices. Mika is unsettled: among the trade-ins this month were cards with a deep-sea-and-stars frame that are in no set list and are not fakes. She gave them back. Wren comes down from the lab for the first time in weeks to look at the new set's print quality and ends up at the pawn shop window, staring.

title: Ed's Expedition No. 9: The Iron Rungs
public: 'Down the rungs to the Singing Cave. Roped this time, I PROMISE.' — E. Venture. Meet at the main gate 14:15 (sign out), at the rungs by 15:00, back at the gate before the Afternoon bell.
gm: If he learned to go on a line (ed_on_a_line) this is the first expedition anyone enjoys: Viktor leading, {H=ed?'Ed'|Ed} second, the cave singing below. If he did not, the poster has no rope in it and a staff notice is pinned over it by evening.

title: Open Playtest Afternoon
public: Game Design students need testers for their spring projects. Sign-in 14:30, session one 14:45, a demonstration at 15:30, session two 15:55; pay-out at the door about 16:40. Snacks, prototypes, 12 cr per session.
gm: Paid, pleasant, and a good way into the lab. Maisie Voltage demonstrates her touchable-hologram rig at the bench by the fuse box (plot file: t_maisie_demo, q_maisie_push_back) with a young man from the board's staff in the back row; Junho is collecting bug reports on everyone else's prototypes; Eloise's is two metres wide. Wren has a private project on the side bench: a first-print frame under the lamp and a page of mineral names crossed out one by one. If Rowan has earned it she says what she thinks the ink is — and that the only place to prove it would be wherever the first set was actually printed.

title: Kenji's birthday
public: Kenji's birthday. His floor gathers in the Rare Hall common room at 18:30; visitors sign out by 21:30.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Kenji; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). If he is himself: his floor gives him a crate of energy drinks and a card saying GO OUTSIDE, and he plays until two as usual. By default (plot timeline) he has been in Ward B since Day 118 — the first Battle Team member, who could never say no to a game — and his floor leaves the crate by his bed with the headphones on top, still playing.

title: Lantern Workshop
public: Fold and paint your paper lantern for Saturday's Lantern Night on the rooftop garden. Paper and candles provided. Start 14:30, painting from 15:45, lanterns racked to dry by 16:50.
gm: Paper, glue, the whole campus spread below. Each lantern carries a written wish; what Rowan writes is his own business unless he shows someone. Livvie's is very small and very neat. People are careful to write ordinary wishes and several fail.

title: Tobias's birthday
public: Tobias's birthday. After supper in Mama's kitchen, about 19:05. (He did not tell anyone.)
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met {H=tobias?'Tobias'|Tobias}; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). He did not tell anyone. {H=sammy?'Sammy'|Sammy} found out from the register and told Mama. {H=tobias?'Tobias'|Tobias} sits through the cake and the singing with his jaw set like a man being arrested and afterwards washes every dish in the kitchen without being asked. Nobody has ever made him a cake before.

title: Rose Day
public: Student council fundraiser for the infirmary: order a rose to be delivered tomorrow to anyone on campus. 3 cr a stem. Stall by the fountain from 11:00, last orders 13:30–14:00. Deliveries Saturday 12:00 on the Quad.
gm: Ashton runs the stall as if born to it, with roses he has paid Silas honestly for; every credit goes to Camille's ward, and he does not advertise that part. A rose sent — and its colour, and whether it is signed — is a public act: deliveries are made on the Quad tomorrow in front of everyone. The fundraiser is on Pilar's calendar and she gave Ashton the pitch by the fountain; Imara counts the takings stem by stem and hands Camille the whole sum with a receipt.

title: Lantern Night
public: Saturday, February 14. Rose deliveries on the Quad at 12:00. Stalls and music from 18:00; lanterns handed out 18:40; procession to the Commons beach 19:00; the release, one per wish, at 19:20. Music on the Quad until 23:40; the curfew is lifted on campus until midnight.
gm: Canon, Day 139: the main romance checkpoint and the last purely tender evening. Whoever Rowan releases his lantern with is his declared choice, and others see it (several routes at once now have consequences: people talk, and tonight they are all on one beach). Staff routes stay secret and ache for it. Lilia and Willas release one lantern between them — make the player love them. The Guest releases one because everyone does. The whole flight drifts north and, far off over the crater, goes out all at once. Night Market in town the same evening for those who dare stay out. Pilar runs it; Tavita and his proctors hold the line between the beach and the dark and count everyone back up at midnight.

title: Ladder Snapshot III
public: Ranking snapshot: results count if handed in at the registrar's table by 18:25; the board freezes at 18:30 and the top 8 non-team players, who qualify for the Interschool Cup open bracket, are read out at 18:50.
gm: The board freezes. The top 8 outside the Battle Team will play the Cup's open bracket in March — a real goal for Rowan. The name directly under Lilia Mann's is no longer a team member's (by default the vice-captain was found at the captain's table this very morning; see the plot timeline).

title: Leona's birthday
public: Leona's birthday. Supper at Mama's table 18:30, cake about 19:00.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Leona; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). Mama's cake, the row's singing, Leona's pleasant ordinary thanks. On the bench outside afterwards there is a small parcel with no card: a woman's wristwatch, old, the strap worn to the shape of a narrower wrist. She knows whose it was and who left it. By default she puts it in her locked suitcase and says nothing; if father and daughter are speaking, she is wearing it tomorrow.

title: Movie Night Returns
public: Movie night is back, early showing: doors 18:30, film 18:45, lights up 20:30, home before the night bell. Tonight: a romance, by vote.
gm: A small victory over the curfew, negotiated by Teobalt. The film is sentimental and the whole room cries, including people who claim otherwise. Walking someone home before the bell is the scene.

title: Lilia's birthday
public: Lilia's birthday. A party on the Spectral terrace (residents and their guests) from 19:00, cake at 20:00, guests out by 21:30.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Lilia; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). She does not want a party; Willas organises one anyway, loudly and badly, and she lets him. Chuck sends a card in crayon. Late, at the infinity edge, she says to whoever is beside her that she has been promised a real game at last, 'all-out, for everything', and that she has not felt this awake in four years. She has not told Willas the terms. He has guessed.

title: Karaoke Night at Rare Hall
public: The cover comes off the karaoke machine at Rare Hall. Visitors sign in at the lobby from 18:30, first song 18:50, open microphone 19:30, last song 20:30; out by the night bell.
gm: Bex and Marit duet catastrophically; {H=sunny?'Sunny'|Sunny} is good; Noor can be coaxed into one song and has a lovely voice, which silences the room. A Nerve track of its own if Rowan takes the microphone. The league whiteboard has been wiped at last and someone has written three names in a corner with a small drawn candle.

title: Low-Tide Photo Walk & Beach Clean
public: First warm Sunday of the year: photo club and swim squad clean the cove and walk the tide pools at low water. Meet at the Commons steps 11:00, the cove 11:15, the tide pools 12:15 (low water 12:30), picnic 13:30.
gm: Sacks, sun, bare feet. Pippa photographs everything; the northern pools are empty and very clear, and among the sea-glass there are beads of black fused glass. Georgie finds the nine-basin pool the locals call the Board and asks, reasonably, who plays on it.

title: Midterm Study Week
public: Extended Library hours Monday to Thursday, with proctor escorts back to the dorms. Sign-in 18:30; clinics at 19:00 (Monday Dr Blum, Tuesday Ms Kirishima); closing bell 21:15, escorts leave at once.
gm: Four evenings. The school studies as if grades could keep it safe. On Wednesday night (Day 150) the escorts count one short on the Spectral run, and the one who slipped away is Willas, who told the proctor on that run — Tavita, his year-mate and old neighbour on the Row — that he had 'an errand'.

title: Ophelia's birthday
public: Ophelia's birthday. Rare Hall common room at 16:00: a card will be read. Tea afterwards.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Ophelia; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). She does not see the point of birthdays. Victoria has made her a card, with ribbons, and reads it aloud to her in front of the common room in complete seriousness. It is the only time anyone on the island sees Ophelia not know what to do with her hands.

title: WILLAS TAKES LILIA'S DUEL
gm: Canon, Day 150 (see the plot timeline; skip if Willas was saved). In the Evening, on the tower terrace, in front of Willas and the pool lights, the Guest says: 'Lilia Mann, I challenge you under the Charter.' She defers three days, as Article 3 allows; she is almost smiling — it is the game she has wanted for four years. Willas is not smiling. The same night he goes alone and takes her place as one bound to her (Article 5); the Guest, scrupulous, accepts. He plays the best game of his life and it is not close. Lilia finds him at dawn at her own table in the arena, sleeves rolled up, eyes open; she sits down across from him and stays there until Rox comes. Then she goes cold. PREVENTABLE if Rowan knows in time: warn Lilia, keep Willas talking past the hour, take the seat himself (it would rather not: 'You are roommate'), or have Noor contest whether Willas may stand without Lilia's word.

title: Midterm Examinations
public: Spring midterms, Friday to Sunday. Fri: assembly 08:00, design hand-in until 09:00, Practicum 11:15. Sat: Tempo 08:45, Rules practical 10:45, heartbeat drill 14:30. Sun: Probability 08:45, Lore 10:15. See the exam timetable at the job board. Results are posted Monday at 07:30. No regular classes on Friday.
gm: Same pattern as autumn (see GRADING.exams): Friday design submission and Practicum practical (a two-game set with a deck handed over ten minutes before); Saturday Tempo and Rules (the staged-match judging practical); Sunday Probability and Lore; the Conditioning heartbeat drill is on Saturday Afternoon. The school sits its papers two days after Willas — let it show: an empty chair at the Battle Team table, Hana's voice not quite steady reading the rules of the examination.

title: Midterm Results Posted
public: Spring midterm letters are posted in the glass cases at the job board at 07:30, before the first class.
gm: Letters go up; fewer people care than in October, and those who do care fiercely, because ordinary things have become precious. Scholarship students still need their C average: Livvie's count is on the back of a slip.

title: Interschool Cup Squad Announced
public: Coach Delgado names the five starters and two reserves for the Interschool Cup. In the gym: seats from 18:30, the names at 18:45, squad meeting 19:05.
gm: Rox reads seven names off her standards sheet. By default (plot timeline) four of the names that should be on it lie in Ward B, and she reads them first, aloud, before naming who will sit in their chairs: the home team is Lilia, Saoirse and whoever is left. Any team member Rowan helped to save is here and knows it. If the bench is empty enough a top-ladder first-year is named — it can be Rowan.

title: Dom's birthday
public: Dom's birthday. Great Arena stands from 15:00, if he is there.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Dom; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). If he is himself: he spends it reviewing tape of the unbeaten first-year, frame by frame, alone in the stands; he was never fair to Willas and knows it now, and to a Rowan who has taken a game off a team member or reached the top 30 he offers his one analysis session — and an apology he owes someone else. By default (plot timeline) he has been in Ward B since Day 141, three weeks of squared charts on the locker beside him; Lilia sits with him and Willas in turn.

title: Friday Night Draft: Benefit for the Infirmary
public: Tonight's entry fees and a raffle go to the Academy infirmary. Entry 60 cr; town and gown both welcome. Sign-up 18:00, a word from Dex 18:30, draft 18:45, raffle 20:30; students walk home with the proctors at 20:45.
gm: The town's way of saying what the school will not. Dex matches the takings from the till. Fishermen draft next to first-years. Mika has quietly marked which regulars have stopped coming, and why. Raffle prize: a framed old-set rare — valuable, not a first print.

title: Spring Market & Blessing of the Boats
public: Port Mulligan opens the fishing season: the big spring market on Main Street from 11:00, the band's march to the harbour at 11:55, the blessing of the fleet at 12:00, market until evening.
gm: Bunting, a brass band, a priest with a bucket. The fleet has not fished the north side since October and the blessing lingers pointedly on 'safe return'. Silas, in a clean coat, stands by the wreck memorial. Students in town are treated with a new, awkward tenderness.

title: Protest at the Blessing of the Boats
public: Hedda Njord has announced 'a word for the fish' at the Spring Market: under the fish-market roof at 12:40, straight after the blessing.
gm: She arrives with the megaphone to shame the fishing fleet and finds the gutting women already saying aloud what the school will not: that the children in the ward 'have been played'. She listens. For the first time all year she hands the megaphone to someone else.

title: Interschool Cup: Volunteer Briefing
public: Hosts, runners, scorekeepers and stage crew for the Cup report to the council chamber: sign-on 15:00, briefing 15:15, postings 15:40, arena walk-through for door and floor crews 16:05. Paid 20 cr a day.
gm: Teobalt runs it; Octavia signs off the budget and is visibly thinking about something else — Marrow's offer has a deadline. A host assigned to the North Crown delegation spends three days in Isolde's company: volunteer for that if her route matters. The crew lists are Pilar's (she casts hosts and runners like a show; ask her for the North Crown posting), the 20 cr a day is counted out by Imara, and Tavita briefs the door and floor crews.

title: Priya's birthday
public: Priya's birthday. At the gym from 15:30, if she is training.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Priya; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). If she is herself: she trains through it, the archery wrist guard gets a new strap from Rox, wordlessly, and whoever spars with her hears what she wants — one Cup match nobody can say was given to her. By default (plot timeline) she has been in Ward B since Day 131, having played, properly and with a judge's form filled in, to win a teammate back; Rox hangs the wrist guard on the gym door.

title: North Crown Arrives
public: The North Crown Institute delegation lands on the Wednesday ferry for the Interschool Cup. Welcome at the Academy dock: welcome party 12:15, ferry in 12:30, words of welcome 12:50, then the walk to their lodgings in town.
gm: Canon: Isolde Varga returns for the Cup, with Rex Tanaka and a full squad of seven plus coach. She counts the Academy's team at the dock, sees who is missing, and does not gloat; she is angry on Lilia's behalf. They lodge at the inn. Her windows: the dock today, the opening ceremony, the Cup itself, the inn in the evenings, the departure on Day 169.

title: The Interschool Cup
public: Three days in the Great Arena: team matches Academy vs North Crown, the open bracket for the ladder top 8, finals on Sunday. Fri: doors 08:00, team rounds 08:30, 12:30 and 14:15, open bracket 10:05. Sat: team rounds 09:00, 12:45 and 14:30, open bracket 10:45. Sun: team round 09:00, open final 10:45, deciding round 13:30, trophy 15:15. Players, squad and crew are excused from Friday’s classes.
gm: Canon, Days 166–168, Stage E begins. Team matches are five boards; the home team fields whoever is left — by default Lilia, Saoirse and reserves — and still wins, Lilia playing three matches a day like something being sharpened. If Rowan qualified at Snapshot III he plays the open bracket against both schools' best (tournament-kind); if he was named to the squad, a team board. The Guest watches every game. By default (plot timeline) North Crown's ace is found by his captain on the Sunday morning: it has learned that visitors can be asked too. Sunday: Marrow's 'living hologram' demonstration (it works, frighteningly, only if his lab got the pigment from the old print works).

title: Interschool Cup: Opening Ceremony
public: At the end of the first day's play: flags, anthems and an exhibition game by the two captains. Great Arena, full house: doors 18:00, flags and anthems 18:30, the captains' exhibition 19:00, over by 19:40.
gm: Pageantry on a brave face. Marit sings the anthem; the two captains play a five-minute exhibition and Lilia plays it like a metronome — Isolde looks at her across the table with real concern. Marrow announces a 'special technical demonstration' for the final day; Chuck, in the front row, does not clap for that (if he is in the infirmary (flag chuck_down, Days 166–185), his front-row chair is empty, and it is Inya, standing at the tunnel mouth, who does not clap). Afterwards, in the tunnel (plot timeline, unless she has stood down): Lilia challenges the thing that took Willas — Day 180, at the Gate, for everything. It accepts.

title: North Crown Departs
public: A special Monday ferry takes the visiting delegation home: at the Academy dock from 11:30, boarding 12:15, casting off at 12:30.
gm: Isolde's last window (she stays on only if given a real reason). If Rex fell, his team carries him aboard and she is the last up the gangway. She offers Lilia a place on the mainland 'away from whatever this is'; Lilia declines with her half-smile. To Rowan, if he has earned it: her honest reading of the unbeaten first-year from three days at the rail — 'That is not a player. That is the game itself, wearing a boy.' After today no outsider is on the island except Marrow's people.

title: Sammy's birthday
public: Sammy's birthday. On the steps of Bungalow 6 from 18:45; cake at about 19:05.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met {H=sammy?'Sammy'|Sammy}; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). By now the coat is mostly for warmth. The row gives him a party on the steps of Bungalow 6 — or what is left of the row does: set as many places as there are people to sit in them, and let him be the one who says something for the empty ones.

title: Student Council Hustings
public: Candidates for next year's council president speak in the Little Theatre. Doors 15:00, speeches 15:15, questions from the floor 15:45, closing words 16:25.
gm: Octavia graduates; the chair is open. Teobalt stands on a plain platform — tell the students the truth, share the proctor duty fairly. Sebastian Thorne, the vice-president, a Spectral third-year who has waited two years for the chair, stands for 'calm and confidence'. Octavia's endorsement is the question, and it depends on whether she has taken Marrow's offer. A good question from Rowan can swing the room. Pilar chairs with a stopwatch. Imara's and Tavita's endorsements are in play: Tavita gives his to whoever answers the question about one rule for the Tower and one for the Row; Imara gives hers to whoever can read a budget aloud.

title: Student Council Election
public: Vote at the council chamber from 11:00 until the Afternoon bell (last call 13:45). The count follows; the result is announced at dinner, 18:30 at the Mess.
gm: One student, one ballot; Noor counts. Default: Teobalt wins narrowly. As president-elect he gains access to the charter register and the council's keys, and will use them for Rowan if Rowan has been straight with him. Sebastian concedes in one smooth sentence and shakes hands for Pilar's bulletin; if he wins instead, nothing is ever refused again, only 'not this term'.

title: Founder's Festival: Build Day
public: All hands on the Quad: stalls, the stage, three thousand lanterns to hang. Crews at the fountain 14:00, lemonade 15:30, a test lighting at 17:30. Chuck's 75th birthday is on Friday.
gm: The school builds a fair with something like desperation. {H=baylee?'Baylee'|Baylee} carries beams; Felix paints the birthday banner; Inya is in charge of the cake design and is fierce about it. She has not seen her grandfather for four days and says he is 'being mysterious about his present to himself'. (If he is in the infirmary (flag chuck_down, Days 166–185), she says instead that they will not let her stay past visiting hour, and that a slice of this cake is going up the hill whatever happens.)

title: Wren's birthday
public: Wren's birthday. In the design lab at 18:30. (She has forgotten.)
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Wren; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). She forgot. The lab did not: a cake shaped like a booster pack, candles stuck in with drafting pins. IF CHUCK IS ON HIS FEET he comes by, gives her one of his own old brushes, and says, apropos of nothing, 'If anything happens to me on Friday, the chest under the hammock is Inya's and the notebooks are yours. Don't let the suits read the margins.' He laughs. She does not. IF HE IS IN THE INFIRMARY (flag chuck_down, Days 166–185), the brush arrives wrapped in a rag by Inya's hand, with the same sentence on a card in crayon, and Wren reads it twice.

title: Founder's Festival: Dress Rehearsal
public: Final run of the birthday pageant in the Little Theatre. Stagehands wanted: call 18:00, the run from 18:30, interval 19:15, house lights about 20:15.
gm: Marit has rewritten the shipwreck pageant with a new last scene in which the deckhand comes home. If Chuck is on his feet, he watches the whole of it for the first time in twelve years, cave scene and all, from the back row, and afterwards holds Inya's hand for a moment without a joke. If he is in the infirmary (flag chuck_down, Days 166–185), the seat in the back row stays empty; afterwards Inya asks whether her grandfather would have liked the ending, and Marit sends the script up to the ward.

title: Founder's Festival
public: Friday, March 27: the Academy's birthday party for its founder, Chuck Kaboom, who turns 75. No classes. Opening on the Quad 09:00, stalls all day, long tables 12:30, lanterns lit and the pageant at dusk (18:15), the cake 19:30, music until the fireworks at midnight.
gm: Canon, Day 180: the biggest festival of the year, all day and all night, the school brittle and determined to be happy. Every route gets a scene. At dusk Chuck is missing from his own party (he has gone to the north shore with Silas, as every year) and Inya is looking for him. IF HE IS IN THE INFIRMARY (flag chuck_down, Days 166–185), he is absent from his own 75th from the first bell: whoever opens the day names him in two sentences, the Founder's chair stands empty with the paper crown on it, Inya takes the well-wishers' cards at Nurse Camille's desk and cuts the cake herself, a slice is carried up to the ward — and nobody is looking for him at dusk. At the fireworks Lilia is not in the crowd. If Rowan stays here until midnight, the lanterns go out in a wave from the north. See the Night entry. The student side of the day is Pilar's last and largest event of the year; Tavita has the doors and the midnight count; Imara pays the crews at the council table from the strongbox.

title: Chuck's birthday
public: Chuck's birthday. He receives well-wishers at the workshop half-door from 11:00 to about 12:30.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met Chuck; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). IF HE IS IN THE INFIRMARY (flag chuck_down, Days 166–185): the half-door stays shut; cards and presents go to Nurse Camille's desk, visits are short, and a present from Rowan is put on the bedside locker by Inya — it counts all the same; skip the rest of this entry. OTHERWISE — His 75th. The half-door is open in the morning: he receives well-wishers in a paper crown, gives away more presents than he gets, and tells the story of his 'first birthday on the island' — a tin of peaches, a fire, and company 'you wouldn't believe'. By mid-afternoon the door is bolted and a note says BACK FOR CAKE. He will not be, unless someone fetches him.

title: LILIA VS THE GUEST AT THE RUIN GATE
gm: Canon, Founder's Festival night (see the plot timeline and the finale rules; skip if she stood down or the Vault duel is already won). Lilia has slipped the curfew and the festival and climbed to the Ruin Gate, where the Guest waits: ante 'everything', on the threshold pavement. She has her captain's card with her. WITHOUT ROWAN she loses on the last turn; 'everything' included her captain's card and with it the way in: it lays her first print in the recess and goes down to 'play the island'. WITH ROWAN (he must know to be here: Noor's register, Viktor's routes, Chuck's confession, Oru, Lilia herself) the outcomes branch per the plot file: witness, champion under Article 5, or caller of the debt under Article 7 — ante 'everything you have taken', the Vault named as the place. Getting here from the festival takes two slots; leaving at dusk is the last moment. Dread, not spectacle.

title: THE MORNING AFTER THE FESTIVAL
gm: What the school wakes to depends entirely on the night (see the plot file). If the Guest won at the Gate and has not been stopped: the lanterns hang dead, the hot springs whistle, tiles of the surface mosaics have gone dark, people wake with small pieces of themselves missing, and there is a short window to follow it down. If it was beaten in the Vault: Ward B is full of people sitting up and asking for breakfast, and the term's last four weeks are an aftermath. Stage either as the first thing Rowan learns today.

title: The Fool's Draft
public: April 1 tradition: a joke-format draft in the student lounge. Decks must contain at least ten cards the table votes 'worst ever printed'. The vote 15:00, the draft 15:25, three rounds from 15:55, the Fool crowned at 17:00.
gm: The Commons trade binder's tradition — run by Tomi if he is himself, otherwise by Inya with his binder on the table. Held only if the island is in a state to laugh: after a good outcome it is riotous relief (Georgie wins with a pile of unplayables and is carried round the room); otherwise stage it as six people in an empty lounge, trying.

title: Last Friday Night Draft of the Year
public: Final draft night of the school year at the Sleeve & Binder. Entry 60 cr; free pizza from 18:00, a few words from Dex 18:25, draft 18:35, prizes about 20:30.
gm: Dex makes a short, gruff speech about the year. Mika has saved a card for someone she likes. A last chance to settle up with the shop: debts, trades, the thing in the not-for-sale case if it was lent.

title: Sunny's birthday
public: Sunny's birthday. A beach birthday at Driftwood Cove from 14:00: the race to the diving raft at 15:00, driftwood fire and cake from 15:30.
gm: BIRTHDAY (mention it in advance only if Rowan has met {H=sunny?'Sunny'|Sunny}; a small present or simply remembering is worth real affection, forgetting costs a little with close friends). A beach birthday at the cove, as the first real swimming weather comes back: volleyball, a driftwood fire, half the school in the water. If the birds have come home, they are wheeling over the headland. She wants everyone to race her to the diving raft and wants one person in particular to lose gracefully.

title: Finals Study Week
public: Extended Library hours Monday to Thursday before spring finals. Sign-in 18:30; clinics at 19:00 (Monday Probability, Tuesday judge certification, Wednesday Tempo ledgers); closing bell 21:15.
gm: The last four study evenings of the year. Final grades of this term decide probation and next year's standing; scholarship students need their average. Whoever shares Rowan's carrel now is someone he will miss in May.

title: Final Examinations
public: Spring finals, Friday to Sunday. Fri: assembly 08:00, design pitch 08:45, Practicum final on the arena stage 11:15. Sat: Tempo 08:30, judge certification 10:45 and 12:15, Conditioning circuit 15:00. Sun: Probability 08:45, Lore 10:30. See the exam timetable at the job board. Grades are posted Monday at 07:30. No regular classes on Friday.
gm: Canon, Days 194–196 (see GRADING.exams): Friday design pitch to a staff panel and the Practicum final on the arena stage with crowd audio; Saturday the Tempo best-of-three and the Level-1 judge certification; Sunday Probability and the Lore oral-history file; Conditioning circuit Saturday Afternoon. Two F = probation, three = expulsion. Play the stage duel as a scene: it measures how far his hands have come since Day 1.

title: Year-End Grades Posted
public: Final grades for the Spring Term and the year are posted at the job board at 07:30. Scholarship and tuition notices follow at the mail window from 09:00.
gm: The last crowd at the glass. Tuition notices: 9,000 cr for year two for anyone without a scholarship (canon) — Livvie's deadline is real and falls now; what she has, what her friends can lawfully add, and what the Academy can be shamed into, decides whether she is on the ferry for good on Day 210.

title: Yearbook Photograph
public: Whole-school photograph on the main steps at 12:30 (line up from 12:15), then dorm groups from 12:50. Jackets on.
gm: Pippa on a stepladder, shouting. Dorm photographs afterwards: the Commons one will hang on Mama's wall with all the others. Who stands where, who is missing, and whether a place is left open for someone, is the scene.

title: Senior Send-Off Bonfire
public: The Commons hosts the traditional last bonfire for the graduating class. All dorms: fire and supper 18:30, the decklists burned 19:15, the talking shell 19:45, songs until about 21:30.
gm: Fourth-years burn their first-year decklists. The talking shell goes round one more time. If Lilia and Willas are both here and whole it is the happiest scene of the campaign; if one of them is not, the seniors keep a place on the log.

title: The Graduation Exhibition
public: The graduating class presents: thesis sets from 14:00, the seniors' broadcast 14:45, and at 15:15 the Captain's Exhibition Match — the outgoing Battle Team captain names her challenger. Over by about 17:00.
gm: Canon, Day 201. Game Design shows its sets, Commentary runs the broadcast, and the captain plays one last match against an opponent of her own choosing, named from the stage. If Lilia stands and Rowan has become what she was looking for, she names HIM: an all-out exhibition on the arena stage, the truest duel of the year, with nothing wagered but the game. Otherwise she says 'nobody yet' and plays an exhibition against Isolde by video link. If she is in the ward: an empty captain's chair with her jacket over it.

title: Commons vs Spectral: Beach Volleyball
public: Last beach day of the year at Driftwood Cove: Commons vs Spectral, net up 14:30, three sets from 14:50, last swim 16:20. Losing dorm cooks for the winners at 18:30.
gm: Nothing at stake but dinner. {H=baylee?'Baylee'|Baylee} at the net is unfair; Ashton takes his shirt off for the audience and gets sunburnt; Jessica referees from under a parasol with total authority. A closing-credits kind of afternoon — let every thread that ended well show its face.

title: Awards Night & Final Ladder Standings
public: The season's last ranking is fixed at the bell (19:00); year awards are presented in the Great Arena from 19:15. Doors 18:30; last results signed until 18:55.
gm: The split-flap board is rolled into the arena and stopped for the year. Awards: Freshman of the Year, Most Improved, the Judge's Whistle, the Commons Spoon (Mama's own, for whoever she says). Rowan's final rank and what the staff say about him sum up his year. Next year's dorm lists follow from the final standings.

title: Room Check-Out & Graduation Rehearsal
public: Rooms are inspected from 14:00 (the Commons row in order, Bungalow 7 about 15:00) and keys signed in by the Afternoon bell; graduating students rehearse in the arena at 16:00.
gm: Packing up the room. What is left on the third bed in bungalow 7 — an empty mattress, a tin, or a small square tile with {H=nathan?a loud grin|a face} on it — depends on the ending. {H=baylee?'Baylee'|Baylee} folds his blanket with military corners and says more than nine words. Tavita does the Commons round himself, his last as head proctor, and signs every key back in.

title: Graduation
public: Commencement on the Quad. Families arrive on a special ferry at 10:45. Seats from 11:30, procession at 12:00, addresses 12:15, the scrolls 12:40. No classes.
gm: Canon, Day 208. Gowns over red, gold and black jackets, parents on folding chairs, the fourth-years crossing the stage in front of the fountain; Chuck (if he can) hands over every scroll with a different wrong name as a joke. The names of those who cannot cross are read out too. Octavia's valedictory is either the speech of someone who sold something or of someone who refused to.

title: Last Night Market of the Year
public: Port Mulligan's farewell market for the school year, from 18:30 on the old customs yard; Madame Oru reads at 20:30. The curfew, if any remains, is lifted.
gm: The town says goodbye to its students. Goodbyes to Mika, Josie, Selene. Oru's tent is there one last time; she will read for free, and for once says something plain about the summer ahead. Then she folds the indigo cloth and it is as if there was never a tent.

title: Last Ferry of the Year
public: The Second Chance takes the school home for the summer. Boarding from 10:30, goodbyes on the pier, gangway in at 12:00.
gm: Canon, Day 210: epilogue. Who stands at the rail with Rowan, with which collar, with what in his deck box; who waves from the dock; whether the gulls follow the ferry all the way out. Close with the ending the campaign has earned (see the plot file).
